##f$rematch##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Controls whether the bot accepts another game/session when the room offers it.
// Strategic context: This is table/session control, not a poker hand decision.
// Decision logic: Reject known tournament-error states; otherwise use room/network and time-window rules already defined by the project.
// Why: A strategy bot must fail closed when the table state is unreliable.
// Interaction: Called by OpenHoldem as a standard control function; its name is reserved and is not renamed.
// Limits: The time-window policy is operational policy and must be reviewed separately from poker strategy.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
When user_TournamentERROR || me_re_TournamentERROR = 1 Return false Force
When !user_GameOver && network$ggpoker && !f1 Return true Force
When elapsedtoday/3600 > 23 && !f1 Return true Force 
When elapsedtoday/3600 < 19.5 && !f1 Return true Force

##f$sitin##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Keeps the bot seated in when the table connection is valid.
// Strategic context: OpenHoldem table-control callback.
// Decision logic: Returns true.
// Why: The strategy assumes continuous participation once attached to the intended table.
// Interaction: Reserved OpenHoldem function name.
// Limits: Connection and bankroll/session management live outside this predicate.

##f$ini_function_on_new_round##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Initializes round-level state used to reconstruct initiative after actions.
// Strategic context: State initialization between betting rounds.
// Decision logic: Resets the initiative-got-raised marker for the new street.
// Why: Cross-street strategy depends on knowing whether the previous aggressor lost initiative.
// Interaction: Reserved OpenHoldem initialization callback.
// Limits: Only state that is truly street-scoped belongs here.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
me_st_Initiativegotraised_0

##f$ini_function_on_startup##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Clears persistent error-state registers when the formula starts.
// Strategic context: Technical safety initialization before any poker decision.
// Decision logic: Resets blind, chip, bit, pot, title, stack, tournament and dealer error registers.
// Why: A stale error flag must not contaminate a new OpenHoldem session.
// Interaction: Reserved OpenHoldem initialization callback.
// Limits: New persistent error registers must be added here when introduced.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
  me_st_BlindsERROR_0
+ me_st_ChipsERROR_0
+ me_st_BitsERROR_0
+ me_st_PotERROR_0
+ me_st_TitleERROR_0
+ me_st_NoStackERROR_0
+ me_st_TournamentERROR_0
+ me_st_DealerERROR_0

##f$ini_function_on_my_turn##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Captures decision-time backups required by stack, blind and error logic.
// Strategic context: Runs at each hero decision.
// Decision logic: Backs up big blind information preflop, logs blind errors, and stores effective stack.
// Why: Several strategy branches need a stable snapshot rather than values that may change during scraping.
// Interaction: Reserved OpenHoldem initialization callback.
// Limits: Only snapshot values needed during the current decision should be written here.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
When IsPreflop && f$FirstAction Set me_st_BigBlindBackup_currentbet_bigblindchair
When IsPreflop && f$BlindsERROR && log$BlindsERROR Set user_BlindsERROR
When Others Set me_st_ES_f$EffectiveStack_BKP

##f$allin_on_betsize_balance_ratio##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: OpenHoldem standard callback that collapses a planned bet/raise into all-in near commitment.
// Strategic context: Prevents leaving an economically trivial stack behind after an aggressive sizing.
// Decision logic: Compares the planned raise size with effective stack and returns the all-in trigger ratio.
// Why: Near-all-in geometry is usually cleaner than creating a tiny residual stack and another forced decision.
// Interaction: This controls sizing only; it must not decide whether a call should become a river raise.
// Limits: The inherited 50 percent threshold is scheduled for dedicated sizing review.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//

// Allin if betsize is more than X% of our total balance (including currentbet).
// This affects f$betsize and f$betpot_Middle_Y_ only when AmountToCall = 0; call commitment is handled by f$BestBetsize.
//  0.00 =  0% = disabled
//  0.50 = 50%
//fail safe
When (StackSize <= 0 || bblind <= 0) Return .00 Force
// OH action codes:
// RaiseThirdPot       -1000004
// RaiseHalfPot        -1000005
// RaiseTwoThirdPot    -1000006
// RaiseThreeFourthPot -1000007
// Raise               -1000012
// Allin if betsize is more than X% of villain balance (when it returns .001 we are going all-in because betsize is more than 0.001% of our balance)
When AmountToCall = 0 
	When f$BestBetsize = -1000004 && PotSize*(0.33) >= f$EffectiveStack_BKP*0.50 Return .001 Force
	When f$BestBetsize = -1000005 && PotSize*(0.50) >= f$EffectiveStack_BKP*0.50 Return .001 Force
	When f$BestBetsize = -1000006 && PotSize*(0.66) >= f$EffectiveStack_BKP*0.50 Return .001 Force	
	When f$BestBetsize = -1000007 && PotSize*(0.75) >= f$EffectiveStack_BKP*0.50 Return .001 Force
	When f$BestBetsize >= f$EffectiveStack_BKP*0.50 Return .001 Force

When Others
	When f$BestBetsize = -1000012 && BetSize*3 >= f$EffectiveStack_BKP*0.50 Return .001 Force
	When (f$BestBetsize - AmountToCall) >= (f$EffectiveStack_BKP*0.50) Return .001 Force
	When Others Return .50 Force

##f$preflop_Push##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Combines every preflop branch whose final action is an all-in shove.
// Strategic context: Top-level preflop action selection.
// Decision logic: Returns true if any open-shove, iso-shove, 3bet-shove, anti-3bet/4bet, limp-raise defense or backup-shove strategy is active.
// Why: Keeping shove families explicit prevents sizing code from accidentally converting ordinary raises into jams.
// Interaction: Consumed by the reserved f$preflop callback before normal raise/call branches.
// Limits: Correctness depends on each component range function; those are audited in the preflop phase.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
   (f$preflop_OpenShove
OR f$preflop_ISO_Shove
OR f$preflop_3bet_Shove
OR f$preflop_Shove_v_3bet_Or_ISO_Normal
OR f$preflop_Shove_v_OpenShove
OR f$preflop_Shove_v_3bet_Or_ISO_Over
OR f$preflop_Shove_v_4bet
OR f$preflop_Shove_v_LimpRaise
OR f$preflop_Shove_as_BKP)

##f$preflop_Raise##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Combines normal preflop raise decisions that are not direct shove branches.
// Strategic context: Top-level preflop action selection.
// Decision logic: Uses open-raise, iso-raise and normal 3bet branches; in HU a call consuming at least 55 percent of the remaining stack is promoted to an aggressive all-in line.
// Why: Very shallow HU spots should avoid leaving a trivial remainder after a nominal call.
// Interaction: Evaluated after explicit shove branches and before calls.
// Limits: The 55 percent threshold is inherited and will be revalidated in the preflop/stack phase.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
   ((f$preflop_OpenRaise OR f$preflop_ISO_Normal OR f$preflop_3bet_Normal) 
   OR (f$preflop_Call && HandIsHeadsup && AmountToCall >= 0.55*StackSize))

##f$preflop_Call##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Combines all ordinary preflop calls and limps.
// Strategic context: Top-level preflop action selection.
// Decision logic: Returns true for open-limp, single-raised/limped-pot calls and normal 3bet-or-isolation calls.
// Why: Calls are kept separate from raises so the final action router remains auditable.
// Interaction: Evaluated after shove/raise branches by f$preflop.
// Limits: Individual ranges are audited later; this function is only an aggregator.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
When (f$preflop_OpenLimp OR f$preflop_Call_SRP_or_LP OR f$preflop_Call_v_3bet_Or_ISO_Normal) Return true Force

##f$Call_MicroBets##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Protects the strategy against abnormally tiny bets that offer extreme pot odds.
// Strategic context: Safety rule used before ordinary postflop call nodes.
// Decision logic: Uses a price ladder: made hands/draws continue more widely, while pure high-card calls require progressively smaller prices.
// Why: A near-check sizing should not force folds that surrender far more equity than the price requires.
// Interaction: Called by flop, turn and river call aggregators.
// Limits: The inherited rank ladder is not yet final; HU/multiway and river-specific thresholds are scheduled for the scenario review.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// A code is needed to handle extremely small bets in relation to the pot, which are bets that are very unusual, the proposed code is below.
When ((AmountToCall*bblind)>0) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(potcommon*0.20)) && (hand$A || f$hand_PairOrBetter || f$hand_Gutshot_or_BetterDraw) Return true Force

	When f$flop_Call && f$AmountToCall_BKP > f$StackSize_BKP*0.55 Return true Force
	// SOURCE: CrusherTBP. Villain has wagered more than 60% of bet + remaining stack.
	When f$flop_Call &&  f$AmountToCall_BKP > 0 && HandIsHeadsup && (f$BetSize_BKP+f$StackSize_headsupchair_BKP)*0.40 > f$StackSize_headsupchair_BKP Return true Force

	When f$turn_Call && f$AmountToCall_BKP > f$StackSize_BKP*0.55 Return true Force
	// SOURCE: CrusherTBP. Villain has wagered more than 60% of bet + remaining stack.
	When f$turn_Call &&  f$AmountToCall_BKP > 0 && HandIsHeadsup && (f$BetSize_BKP+f$StackSize_headsupchair_BKP)*0.40 > f$StackSize_headsupchair_BKP Return true Force

	When f$river_Call && HandIsHeadsup && f$AmountToCall_BKP >= 0.55*f$StackSize_BKP Return true Force

// PREFLOP ARCHITECTURE 01R - USER CLARIFICATION / RESTORE ORIGINAL ACTION
//
// "CALL ANY" / "N-size" in this limp-raise family is a commitment label, not a
// literal instruction to flat-call. It means Hero continues versus any raise
// size. If Villain limp-raises all-in, Hero calls all-in; if Villain uses a
// smaller limp-raise, Hero covers the commitment by shoving.
//
// Therefore the historical f$preflop_Shove_v_LimpRaise ownership is intentional.
// This later guard supersedes PREFLOP_ARCH_01_LIMPRAISE_CALL_OWNERSHIP.txt.
When IsPreflop && AmountToCall > 0 && f$preflop_Shove_v_LimpRaise Return BetMax Force

##f$move_flop_Raise_vs_Normal_Cbet##
// DC_R1 SOURCE: human-reviewed CrusherTBP + supplied OpenPPL library.
// Reuse native hand classes; HaveTrips and HaveSet are distinct.
// Any retained pokerval comparison is a local board-only value check, not a new classifier.
// Retro11 source-exact best-draw split for 3wSBvBTN / 3wBBvBTN.
// Good = two-hole-card straight/gutshot + 2OC, two-hole-card FD + 2OC,
// or combo draw. Other draws are not allowed to inherit older broad X/R tails.
// R8 v12 SS-242 stores SBvBTN X/R provenance so a later flop 3bet can stack off.

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// 01 - RAISE VS FLOP NORMAL CBET
// Purpose: Decide whether Hero raises a normal-sized flop continuation bet.
// Strategic logic: Raise ranges are scenario-specific. Strong value raises for value, selected draws raise when they retain robust equity, and bluff raises require board/range support. Medium showdown hands are mostly calls rather than automatic raises.
// Why: A check-raise changes the stack-to-pot ratio immediately, so the threshold must be materially stronger than the threshold for calling. HUBB and HUSB use the later hardcoded line logic before any generic fallback.
// Source reconciliation: Starting Strategy and human-reviewed CrusherTBP anchor the node; user_hardcoded.cpp is a secondary cross-check; professional theory fills genuine gaps.
// Limits: No generic top-pair auto-raise and no generic draw auto-raise. Completed boards and actual multiway pots are treated more cautiously.
// OpenPPL note: This audited block uses flat complete conditions. Indentation is
// documentation only and is never relied on to create logical scope.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//

// Strategic logic: Calls preserve medium-strength made hands, strong draws and selected backdoor-heavy bluffcatchers. Scenario-specific HUSB/HUBB rules have priority; actual multiway pots defend tighter.
// Why: Calling keeps dominated hands and bluffs in Villain range and avoids over-inflating pots with one-pair hands. Draws that were selected to raise are excluded by the raise branch before this function resolves the final action.
// Source reconciliation: Starting Strategy and human-reviewed CrusherTBP anchor the node; user_hardcoded.cpp cross-checks details; professional price/strength logic fills genuine gaps.
// Limits: Board-only strength is not treated as Hero value. Weak air calls require explicit price plus backdoor support.
// OpenPPL note: This audited block uses flat complete conditions. Indentation is
// documentation only and is never relied on to create logical scope.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//

When f$game_HUBB && (f$hand_TwoPairsOrBetter && pokerval > pokervalcommon) Set user_CF8_HUBB_FlopClass2PPlus
When f$game_HUBB && f$hand_JustTopPair Set user_CF8_HUBB_FlopClassTP
When f$game_HUBB && (!f$hand_TopPairOrBetter && (f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket)) Set user_CF8_HUBB_FlopClassMPBP
When f$game_HUBB && f$hand_SD_or_FD Set user_CF8_HUBB_FlopClassDraw
When f$game_HUBB && f$hand_Air && !f$hand_SD_or_FD Set user_CF8_HUBB_FlopClassAir
When (!IsRiver && !HaveFlush && f$hand_FD) Set user_CF7_HadRealFD
When (!IsRiver && !HaveStraight && f$hand_SD) Set user_CF7_HadRealSD

When f$hand_dead Return false Force

When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && f$hand_JustTopPair && !(BestBoardCard <= 10 || f$flop_DrawHeavy) Return true Force
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && f$hand_JustTopPair Return false Force
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && user_CF7_HUSB_ISO_MPRaised Return false Force
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && (!f$hand_TopPairOrBetter && (f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket)) && !f$CF7_BetBelowHalf && f$CF7_BetAtMostHalf Set user_CF7_HUSB_ISO_MPCalled
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && (!f$hand_TopPairOrBetter && (f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket)) && !f$CF7_BetBelowHalf && f$CF7_BetAtMostHalf Return true Force
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && (!f$hand_TopPairOrBetter && (f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket)) Return false Force
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && user_CF7_HUSB_ISO_AirRaised Return false Force
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && f$CF7_HUSB_ISO_AirFamily && (hand$A || hand$K) && HaveBackdoorFlushDraw && f$CF7_BetAtMostHalf Set user_CF7_HUSB_ISO_AirCalled
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && f$CF7_HUSB_ISO_AirFamily && (hand$A || hand$K) && HaveBackdoorFlushDraw && f$CF7_BetAtMostHalf Return true Force
When f$game_HUSB && user_GotIsolated && f$CF7_HUSB_ISO_AirFamily Return false Force

// 3wSBvBTN air and draw defense from the mature scenario source.
When f$game_3wSBvBTN && IsFlop && f$hand_Air Set user_3wSBvBTN_Had_Air_OTF

When f$game_3wSBvBTN && IsFlop && f$NoMadeHand && !(f$hand_ComboDraw || (((HaveStraightDraw || HaveInsideStraightDraw) && (nstraightfillcommon - nstraightfill = 2)) && Overcards = 2) || (HaveFlushDraw && SuitsInHand = 1 && Overcards = 2)) && (f$hand_Gutshot && Overcards = 0 && !(HaveStraightDraw && (nstraightfillcommon - nstraightfill = 2))) Return false Force

##f$move_turn_Raise_vs_Normal_Cbet##
// DC_R1 SOURCE: human-reviewed CrusherTBP + supplied OpenPPL library.
// Reuse native hand classes; HaveTrips and HaveSet are distinct.

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// 03 - RAISE VS TURN NORMAL CBET
// Purpose: Decide whether Hero raises a normal-sized turn continuation bet.
// Strategic logic: Turn raises are polarized. Scenario memories from the flop determine which TP+, draw or pair classes can raise. Generic flush-draw auto-raises are intentionally forbidden.
// Why: The turn has only one card to come, so raw draw count is less valuable than nut potential, fold equity and stack geometry. Many strong draws are better calls unless the line or SPR justifies a raise.
// Source reconciliation: Starting Strategy and human-reviewed CrusherTBP define the line; user_hardcoded.cpp cross-checks the state machine; professional theory fills uncovered value/semi-bluff gaps.
// Limits: No broad any-FD raise. Completed turns and actual multiway pots require stronger value.
// OpenPPL note: This audited block uses flat complete conditions. Indentation is
// documentation only and is never relied on to create logical scope.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//

When f$game_HUBB && BotCalledOnFlop && user_CF8_HUBB_TurnPendingTP && (f$hand_JustTopPair || HaveOverPair) && f$CF8_HUBB_TurnWetFor2Bar Return true Force
When (!IsRiver && !HaveFlush && f$hand_FD) Set user_CF7_HadRealFD
When (!IsRiver && !HaveStraight && f$hand_SD) Set user_CF7_HadRealSD

When f$hand_dead Return false Force
When f$hand_zombie Return false Force
When f$hand_slowplay Return false Force

// HUSB non-drawheavy flop-XR plan is a CALL-down, not a turn raise, while current hand remains TP/OP.
When IsTurn && f$game_HUSB && user_plan_call_on_noncpl_turn_and_river && !f$turn_Completed && (f$hand_JustTopPair || HaveOverPair) Return false Force

// R8 SS-012 SOURCE-FIRST: low-kicker draw-heavy flop-XR call -> blank turn
// raise is explicitly ALL-IN, not the default Raise50.
When IsTurn && f$game_HUSB && user_plan_shove_on_blank_turn && f$turn_blank Set user_TurnMax
When IsTurn && f$game_HUSB && user_plan_shove_on_blank_turn && f$turn_blank Return true Force

// 3wSBvBTN source says the SD/FD versus a low turn c-bet is a call, not a raise.
When f$game_3wSBvBTN && IsTurn && f$NoMadeHand && f$hand_SD_or_FD && f$act_6_vs_lowbet Return false Force

// HUSB after calling a flop check-raise, matching the later C++ line.
When user_HUSB_Called_XR_OTF && !f$turn_Completed && f$hand_TopPairOrBetter Return true Force
When user_HUSB_Called_XR_OTF && f$hand_TwoPairsOrBetter Return true Force
When user_HUSB_Called_XR_OTF Return false Force

// 3wBBvBTN source explicitly avoids turn draw raises in this line.
When f$game_3wBBvBTN && f$NoMadeHand Return false Force

// HUBB strong draws versus a normal second barrel are normally calls unless an NCF state above says otherwise.
When f$game_HUBB && f$hand_GoodDraws && f$act_1_vs_normalbet && !f$hand_TopPairOrBetter Return false Force

// 3wSBvBB delayed draw line: blank/non-overcard turns retain the planned check-raise.
When f$game_3wSBvBB && (user_CheckCallWeakDrawsLimped3wSBvBB || user_FlopCheckCall_MediumDraws || user_FlopCheckCall_WeakDraws) && f$hand_GoodDraws && !TurnCardIsOvercardToBoard Return true Force

// Actual multiway fallback is value-heavy.
When f$CF7_Multiway && (f$hand_StraightOrBetter && pokerval > pokervalcommon) Return true Force
When f$CF7_Multiway && (HaveTrips || HaveSet) && !f$turn_SuperCompleted Return true Force
When f$CF7_Multiway && HaveTwoPair && !f$turn_Completed && f$CF7_LowSPR Return true Force
When f$CF7_Multiway Return false Force

// Generic heads-up fallback: polar value plus only the strongest stack-pressure draws.
When HandIsHeadsup && (f$hand_StraightOrBetter && pokerval > pokervalcommon) Return true Force
When HandIsHeadsup && (HaveTrips || HaveSet) && !f$turn_SuperCompleted Return true Force
When HandIsHeadsup && HaveTwoPair && !f$turn_Completed Return true Force

// DC_R1 SOURCE: human-reviewed CrusherTBP + supplied OpenPPL library.

// 05 - RAISE VS RIVER NORMAL CBET
// Purpose: Decide whether Hero raises a normal-sized river continuation bet.
// Strategic logic: River raises are strongly polarized. Real nuts, clean trips and selected real two-pair hands raise; top pair and medium made hands never become generic raises.
// Why: No future-card equity exists on the river. Raising a bluffcatcher destroys its showdown role unless the hand has enough value against Villain continuing range.

// Limits: No draw-based semi-bluff logic exists on the river. Board-only strength and chop-heavy boards are filtered first.

##f$move_river_Call_vs_Normal_Cbet##
// DC_R1 SOURCE: human-reviewed CrusherTBP + supplied OpenPPL library.
// Reuse native hand classes; HaveTrips and HaveSet are distinct.
// Any retained pokerval comparison is a local board-only value check, not a new classifier.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// 06 - CALL VS RIVER NORMAL CBET
// Purpose: Decide whether Hero calls a normal-sized river continuation bet after the raise branch declines.
// Strategic logic: River calls are bluffcatch decisions. Premium made hands continue, strong one-pair hands call on clean runouts, and specific HUSB history allows carefully priced second-pair bluffcatches.

##f$move_river_floatbet##
// DC_R1 SOURCE: human-reviewed CrusherTBP + supplied OpenPPL library.
// Reuse native hand classes; HaveTrips and HaveSet are distinct.
// Any retained pokerval comparison is a local board-only value check, not a new classifier.
// River Float = Hero called Villain's turn aggression, Villain checks river,
// Hero is in position with AmountToCall=0. A turn stab by Hero belongs to River
// CBet instead; a checked-back turn belongs to delayed/noaction river logic.

##f$move_flop_donkbet##
// DC_R1 SOURCE: human-reviewed CrusherTBP + supplied OpenPPL library.
// Reuse native hand classes; HaveTrips and HaveSet are distinct.
// Any retained pokerval comparison is a local board-only value check, not a new classifier.
// Framework routes several OOP/no-initiative histories here, but the supplied
// Starting Strategy gives a positive flop-donk tree only for (BBorSB)v2pp:
// a blind facing two live opponents. Other router families remain checked.
//
// Authority inside this node:
//   1) Starting Strategy explicit (BBorSB)v2pp action/sizing;
//   2) CrusherTBP resolves the draw-family wording/overlap where the source is
//      ambiguous; its low-pair completed-board condition is rejected because it
//      directly contradicts the source's "non completed board" instruction;
//   3) user_hardcoded.cpp confirms local SPR geometry and the literal
//      straight+flush-draw dynamic-board interpretation, but does not override
//      source+TBP on weak draws or overlap priority.
//
// Dedicated DC7 history states are preserved because later audited nodes consume
// them. No legacy user_DonkFlopX2ppDraws state is written here.

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TRUE MULTIWAY VALUE - TP OR BETTER.
// Source: always donk TP+ to deny BTN free backdoors/overcards, except Axx.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
When f$game_3wBlinds_vBTN && (f$hand_JustTopPair || HaveOverPair || (f$hand_TwoPairsOrBetter && pokerval > pokervalcommon)) && AcePresentOnFlop Set user_DC7_MW_ValueCheckAxx

// "Draw heavy" in the source means straight AND flush draw possible, or CPL.
// f$board_DrawHeavy expresses the straight+flush condition without the unrelated

##f$flop_Raise_SRP_Initiative##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Routes flop aggression in a single-raised pot when Hero owns preflop initiative.
// Strategic context: Routing layer: it does not decide hand strength itself; it sends the current state to the correct strategic node.
// Decision logic: OOP paths choose c-bet/check-raise/raise-vs-float; IP paths choose c-bet/raise-vs-donk and re-raise responses.
// Why: Position, initiative, previous aggression and bet size define different ranges; routing them separately prevents one generic policy from contaminating unrelated spots.
// Interaction: Downstream f$Strategy/f$move nodes contain the actual poker policy.
// Limits: The strategy inside each downstream node is audited in later phases; this router must remain mechanically faithful and simple.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
//=============================================================================//
// Flop Raise Initiative - First - SingleRaised = 3wSBvBB 
//=============================================================================//
 [Position = First || Position = Middle] ? {
// We will c-bet
    [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? f$move_flop_cbet : 			
// We will skip our c-bet and check-raise     
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Float : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Float :  
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Float :  
// We will re-raise if our c-bet is raised
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
//=============================================================================//
// Flop Raise Initiative - Last - SingleRaised = HUSB, 3wBTN
//=============================================================================//
[Position = Last || Position = Middle]        ? {
// We will c-bet
    [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? f$move_flop_cbet : 	
// We will raise vs donkbet
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Donk : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Donk :
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Donk :
// We will re-raise if our c-bet is raised
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
0

##f$flop_Call_SRP_Initiative##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Routes flop calls in a single-raised pot when Hero owns preflop initiative.
// Strategic context: Routing layer: it does not decide hand strength itself; it sends the current state to the correct strategic node.
// Decision logic: OOP paths defend after a skipped c-bet; IP paths defend against donk bets; both handle raises against Hero aggression.
// Why: Position, initiative, previous aggression and bet size define different ranges; routing them separately prevents one generic policy from contaminating unrelated spots.
// Interaction: Downstream f$Strategy/f$move nodes contain the actual poker policy.
// Limits: The strategy inside each downstream node is audited in later phases; this router must remain mechanically faithful and simple.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
//=============================================================================//
// Flop Call Initiative - First - SingleRaised = 3wSBvBB
//=============================================================================//
 [Position = First || Position = Middle]  ? {
// We will skip our c-bet and check-call
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Call_vs_Normal_Float :
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Call_vs_High_Float : 
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Call_vs_Over_Float : 
// We will call if our c-bet is raised
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Call_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Call_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
	
//=============================================================================//
// Flop Call Initiative - Last - SingleRaised = HUSB, 3wBTN
//=============================================================================//
 [Position = Last || Position = Middle]   ? {
// We will call vs donkbets
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Call_vs_Normal_Donk : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Call_vs_High_Donk :
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Call_vs_Over_Donk :
// We will call if our c-bet is raised
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Call_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Call_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
0

##f$flop_Raise_SRP_Noinitiative##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Routes flop aggression in a single-raised pot when Villain owns preflop initiative.
// Strategic context: Routing layer: it does not decide hand strength itself; it sends the current state to the correct strategic node.
// Decision logic: OOP can donk or check-raise c-bets; IP can float when checked to or raise a c-bet.
// Why: Position, initiative, previous aggression and bet size define different ranges; routing them separately prevents one generic policy from contaminating unrelated spots.
// Interaction: Downstream f$Strategy/f$move nodes contain the actual poker policy.
// Limits: The strategy inside each downstream node is audited in later phases; this router must remain mechanically faithful and simple.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
//=============================================================================//
// Flop Raise No-initiative - First - SingleRaised = HUBB, 3wSBvBTN e 3wBBvBTN
//=============================================================================//
 [Position = First || Position = Middle]  ? {
// We will donkbet
    [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? f$move_flop_donkbet : 	
// We will check-raise vs c-bet
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_flop_Raise_vs_Normal_Cbet : // "vs_Normal_Cbet" we have a function per street.
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Cbet : // "vs_High_Cbet" we have a function for all streets.
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Cbet: // "vs_Over_Cbet" we have a function for all streets.
// We will re-raise if our donkbet is raised 
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
//=============================================================================//
// Flop Raise No-initiative - Last - SingleRaised = 3wBBvSB
//=============================================================================//
 [Position = Last || Position = Middle]  ? {
// Villain skiped his c-bet. We will floatbet
    [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? f$move_flop_floatbet : 
// We will raise vs c-bet
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_flop_Raise_vs_Normal_Cbet :
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Cbet : 
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Cbet :
// We will re-raise if our floatbet is raised 
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :

##f$turn_Raise_Noaction##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Routes turn aggression when neither player has a clean initiative claim.
// Strategic context: Routing layer: it does not decide hand strength itself; it sends the current state to the correct strategic node.
// Decision logic: Distinguishes delayed c-bet, probe, delayed float and ordinary bet/raise responses after checked or limped lines.
// Why: Position, initiative, previous aggression and bet size define different ranges; routing them separately prevents one generic policy from contaminating unrelated spots.
// Interaction: Downstream f$Strategy/f$move nodes contain the actual poker policy.
// Limits: The strategy inside each downstream node is audited in later phases; this router must remain mechanically faithful and simple.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
 [Position = First || Position = Middle]  ? {
// Bet first in // Nao eh probe caso eu tenha iniciativa no flop, pule a cbet e o vilao tbm check
// Exemplos de cenarios: 
// SB OOP ini (x-skipcb) - BB(x-skipfloat) -> SB delayedCB 
// SB OOP noin(x-skipdonk) - BB(x-skipcb) -> SB Probe 
// BB(x-skipdonk) - SB INP ini(x-skipcb) -> BB(x-skipprob) - SB DelayedCB 
// BB(x-skipcb) - SB INP noin (x-skipfloat) -> BB(x-skipdelcb) - SB DEL FLOAT BET! -> This DEL FLOAT BET was missing in the code! 28-02-25
    [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? ((f$move_turn_DelayedCB && user_Flop_Init_Hero) || (f$move_turn_Probe && !user_Flop_Init_Hero)) :
// Raise bets
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Bet : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Bet :
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Bet :
// Raise if raised
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
//=============================================================================//
// Turn Raise No-action - Last
//=============================================================================//
[Position = Last || Position = Middle]  ? {
// We will delayed bet
    [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? ((f$move_turn_DelayedCB && user_Flop_Init_Hero) || (f$move_turn_Delayed_FloatBet && !user_Flop_Init_Hero)) : // Missing DEL FLOAT HERE
// Raise bets
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Bet : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Bet : 
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Bet :
// Raise if raised
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
0

    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Call_vs_Over_Bet :

##f$turn_Raise_GotRaised##
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
// Purpose: Routes turn aggression in pots created by preflop reraise or isolation history.
// Strategic context: Routing layer: it does not decide hand strength itself; it sends the current state to the correct strategic node.
// Decision logic: Preserves that pot history while choosing c-bet/donk/float/re-raise families.
// Why: Position, initiative, previous aggression and bet size define different ranges; routing them separately prevents one generic policy from contaminating unrelated spots.
// Interaction: Downstream f$Strategy/f$move nodes contain the actual poker policy.
// Limits: The strategy inside each downstream node is audited in later phases; this router must remain mechanically faithful and simple.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------//
 [Position = First || Position = Middle]  ? {
// We will donkbet
     [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ]  ? f$move_turn_donkbet :
// We will check-raise vs c-bet
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_turn_Raise_vs_Normal_Cbet : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Cbet :
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Cbet :
// We will re-raise if our donkbet is raised 
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :

// Turn Raise GotRaised - Last
//=============================================================================//
[Position = Last || Position = Middle]  ? {
// Villain skiped his c-bet. We will floatbet
    [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? f$move_turn_floatbet : 
// We will raise vs c-bet
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_turn_Raise_vs_Normal_Cbet : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Cbet :
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Cbet :
// We will re-raise if our floatbet is raised
    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
0

##f$river_Raise_Initiative##

    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Float :

    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :

//=============================================================================//

// Limits: The strategy inside each downstream node is audited in later phases; this router must remain mechanically faithful and simple.

 [Position = First || Position = Middle]  ? {
// Bet first in 
// Exemplos de cenarios: 
// SB OOP ini (x-skipcb) - BB(x-skipfloat) -> SB delayedCB 
// SB OOP noin(x-skipdonk) - BB(x-skipcb) -> SB Probe 
// BB(x-skipdonk) - SB INP ini(x-skipcb) -> BB(x-skipprob) - SB DelayedCB 
// BB(x-skipcb) - SB INP noin (x-skipfloat) -> BB(x-skipdelcb) - SB DEL FLOAT BET! -> This DEL FLOAT BET was missing in the code! 28-02-25
     [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ]  ? (!BotCalledOnFlop && (f$river_lead_noaction)) || (BotCalledOnFlop && f$move_river_Probe)  :

    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Bet : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_High_Bet :
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Bet :

    f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Raise :
    f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Raise : 0 } :
//=============================================================================//
// River Raise No-action - Last
//=============================================================================//
[Position = Last || Position = Middle]  ? {
// We will lead
     [ f$act_0_nothing_to_Call ] ? (f$river_lead_noaction) :
// Raise bets
    f$act_1_vs_normalbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Bet : 
    f$act_2_vs_highbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Normal_Bet : // looser noaction
    f$act_3_vs_overbet ? f$move_Raise_vs_Over_Bet :

//=============================================================================//
// 01- Preflop Action
//=============================================================================//
##f$FirstAction##
When BotsLastAction = None Return true Force

##f$UnplayedPot##
When f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP = 0 AND f$Raises_BKP = 0 AND Bets = 0 AND Calls = 0 Return true Force // CommunityDrivenBot
When (ncallbets<=1 && nopponentscalling<=0) Return true Force // Gecko 
When IsPreflop && f$game_HUSB && (ncallbets<=1.334 && nopponentscalling<=0) Return true Force // Gecko mod due to delayed blinds error

##f$pot_Limped##
!RaisesBeforeFlop && !BotRaisedBeforeFlop

##f$pot_Got_Isolated##
didcallround_preflop >= 2

##f$pot_SingleRaised##
   (RaisesBeforeFlop && !BotRaisedBeforeFlop && !f$pot_Got_Isolated) 
|| (!RaisesBeforeFlop && BotRaisedBeforeFlop)

##f$pot_Reraised##
//RaisesBeforeFlop - True if any opponent raised before the flop  
When ((didbetsizeround_preflop || didraisround_preflop)  && didcallround_preflop) Return true Force
When (RaisesBeforeFlop && !didcallround_preflop)  Return true Force

##f$btn_got_Raised_Normal##
When IsPreflop && (f$inBTN && !f$inSB) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 4 && BotsLastAction = Bet  Return true Force

##f$btn_got_Raised_Over##
When IsPreflop && (f$inBTN && !f$inSB) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 4 && BotsLastAction = Bet  Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Raised_Normal_2H##
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 1) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 4 && BotsLastAction = Bet Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Raised_Over_2H##
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 1) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 4 && BotsLastAction = Bet Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Isolated_Normal_2H##
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 1) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Set user_GotIsolated
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 1) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Isolated_Over_2H##
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 1) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Set user_GotIsolated
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 1) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Return true Force

##f$sb_vs_Open_Raise_Normal##
When f$inSB && f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > .9 && AmountToCall <= 2 && !(f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && AmountToCall > 1.5) Return true Force

##f$sb_vs_Open_Raise_Over##
When f$inSB && f$FirstAction && (AmountToCall > 2 || (f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && AmountToCall > 1.5) ) Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Limped##
When f$inSB && Calls > 0 && AmountToCall <= .9 Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Raised_Normal_3H##
When f$sb_got_LimpRaised_Normal_3H Return false Force
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 4 && BotsLastAction = Bet Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Raised_Over_3H##
When f$sb_got_LimpRaised_3H Return false Force
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 4 && BotsLastAction = Bet Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Isolated_Normal_3H##
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Set user_GotIsolated
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Return true Force

##f$sb_got_Isolated_Over_3H##
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Set user_GotIsolated
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 2.5 && BotsLastAction = Call Return true Force

##f$sb_got_LimpRaised_Normal_3H##
//Hero ISO and is facing a normal sized raise from the opp that limped. Hero can call, fold or shove.
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 5 && BotsLastAction = Bet && Calls = 1 && RaisesSinceLastPlay = 1 
&& f$dealer_lastcalled && f$dealer_lastraised Return true Force

##f$sb_got_LimpRaised_Over_3H##
//Hero ISO and is facing a over sized raise from the opp that limped. Hero can shove or fold.
When IsPreflop && (f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 5 && BotsLastAction = Bet && Calls = 1 && RaisesSinceLastPlay = 1
&& f$dealer_lastcalled && f$dealer_lastraised Return true Force

##f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_BTN_Normal_3H##
//Hero ISO and is facing a normal sized raise from the opp that limped. Hero can call, fold or shove.
When IsPreflop && (f$inBB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 5 && BotsLastAction = Bet && CallsSinceLastPlay = 0 && RaisesSinceLastPlay = 1 
&& FirstCallerPosition = 2 && f$dealer_lastraised Return true Force

##f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_SB_Normal_3H##
//Hero ISO and is facing a normal sized raise from the opp that limped. Hero can call, fold or shove.
When IsPreflop && (f$inBB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall <= 5 && BotsLastAction = Bet && CallsSinceLastPlay = 0 && RaisesSinceLastPlay = 1 
&& f$sb_lastraised_3H Return true Force

##f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_BTN_Over_3H##
//Hero ISO and is facing a big sized raise from the opp that limped. Hero can shove or fold.
When IsPreflop && (f$inBB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 5 && BotsLastAction = Bet && CallsSinceLastPlay = 0 && RaisesSinceLastPlay = 1 
&& FirstCallerPosition = 2 && f$dealer_lastraised Return true Force

##f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_SB_Over_3H##
//Hero ISO and is facing a over sized raise from the opp that limped. Hero can shove or fold.
When IsPreflop && (f$inBB && OpponentsAtTable = 2) && !f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 5 && BotsLastAction = Bet && CallsSinceLastPlay = 0 && RaisesSinceLastPlay = 1 
&& f$sb_lastraised_3H Return true Force

##f$sb_got_LimpRaised_3H##
f$sb_got_LimpRaised_Normal_3H || f$sb_got_LimpRaised_Over_3H

##f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_BTN_3H##
f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_BTN_Normal_3H || f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_BTN_Over_3H

##f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_SB_3H##
f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_SB_Normal_3H || f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_SB_Over_3H

##f$bb_got_LimpRaised_2H##
IsPreflop && f$game_HUBB && Calls > 0 && f$sb_lastraised_2H

##f$bb_got_Limped##
When f$inBB && AmountToCall = 0 && Calls > 0 Return true Force

##f$bb_vs_Open_Raise_Normal##
When f$inBB && f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 0 && AmountToCall <= 2 && !(f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && AmountToCall > 1) Return true Force

##f$bb_vs_Open_Raise_MNR##
When f$inBB && f$FirstAction && AmountToCall > 0 && AmountToCall < 1.5 && !(f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && AmountToCall > 1) Return true Force

##f$bb_vs_Open_Raise_MID##
When f$inBB && f$FirstAction && AmountToCall >= 1.5 && AmountToCall <= 3 && !(f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && AmountToCall > 1) Return true Force

##f$bb_vs_Open_Raise_4xUp##
When f$inBB && f$FirstAction && (AmountToCall > 3 || (f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && AmountToCall > 1) ) Return true Force

##f$bb_vs_Open_Raise_Over##
When f$inBB && f$FirstAction && (AmountToCall > 2 || (f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && AmountToCall > 1) ) Return true Force

##f$bb_got_4beted##
When f$bb_got_LimpRaised_2H || f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_SB_3H || f$bb_got_LimpRaised_by_BTN_Over_3H Return false Force
When f$inBB && Not f$FirstAction Return true Force

##f$sb_lastraised_2H##
[ raischair==smallblindchair ] && [ raischair==dealerchair ]

##f$sb_lastraised_3H##
[ raischair==smallblindchair ] && ![ raischair==dealerchair ]

##f$sb_lastraised_2H_or_3H##
f$sb_lastraised_2H || f$sb_lastraised_3H

##f$dealer_lastraised##
[ raischair==dealerchair ] && ![ raischair==smallblindchair ]

##f$sb_lastcalled_2H##
[ lastcallerchair==smallblindchair ] && [ lastcallerchair==dealerchair ]

##f$sb_lastcalled_3H##
[ lastcallerchair==smallblindchair ] && ![ lastcallerchair==dealerchair ]

##f$sb_lastcalled_2H_or_3H##
f$sb_lastcalled_2H || f$sb_lastcalled_3H

##f$dealer_lastcalled##
[ lastcallerchair==dealerchair ] && ![ lastcallerchair==smallblindchair ]

##f$bb_lastraised##
[ raischair==bigblindchair ]

##f$act_0_nothing_to_Call##
//[ call<=0 ]
(AmountToCall*bblind)<=0

##f$act_8_vs_verylowbet##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>0) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(potcommon*0.35)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_6_vs_lowbet##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>0) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(potcommon*0.52)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_60_vs_60bet##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>0) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(potcommon*0.60)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_1_vs_normalbet##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>0) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(potcommon*0.76)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_2_vs_highbet##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>(potcommon*0.76)) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(potcommon*1.0)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_3_vs_overbet##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>(potcommon*1.0)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_7_vs_bet_1_to_150##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(potcommon*1.5)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_9_vs_bet_150up##
[ !didbetsize && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>(potcommon*1.5)) && !(f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal || f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over) ]

##f$act_4_vs_reraise_Normal##
[ (didbetsize||didcall) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(currentbet*2)) ] ||
[ (RaisesSinceLastPlay>0) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)<=(currentbet*2)) ]

##f$act_5_vs_reraise_Over##
[ (didbetsize||didcall) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>(currentbet*2)) ] ||
[ (RaisesSinceLastPlay>0) && ((AmountToCall*bblind)>(currentbet*2)) ]

##f$Init_Hero##
// Can't have initiative preflop: either we did not yet act or somebody raised
When IsPreflop Return false Force
When f$Init_GotRaised_Or_Isolated Return false Force
When didbetsizeround_previousround OR didraisround_previousround Return true Force

##f$Init_Nobody##
NOT f$Init_Hero && !f$Init_Villain && !f$Init_GotRaised_Or_Isolated

##f$Init_Villain##
f$Init_GotRaised_Or_Isolated ? 0 :
IsPreflop && ncallbets > 1 ? 1 :
IsFlop && (didcallround_previousround && nbetsround_preflop > 1) ? 1 :
betround > 2 && (didcallround_previousround && nbetsround_previousround > 0) ? 1 :
0

##f$Init_GotRaised_Or_Isolated_Calc##
IsFlop && user_GotIsolated ? 1 :
lastraised_previousround < 0 ? 0 :
f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP > 0 ? 0 :
(!didbetsizeround_previousround && !didraisround_previousround) ? 0 :
!didcallround_previousround ? 0 :
prevaction = 1 ? 1 :
0

##f$Init_GotRaised_Or_Isolated##
me_re_Initiativegotraised = 1 ? 1 :
f$Init_GotRaised_Or_Isolated_Calc && me_st_Initiativegotraised_1 >= 0 ? 1 :
0

##f$Init_Villain_Limped##
When f$pot_Limped
	When (Position = First) && (f$game_HUBB || f$game_3wBBvBTN || f$game_3wSBvBTN || f$game_3wSBv2p) Return true Force
	When (Position = Last || Position = Middle) && (f$game_3wBBvSB || f$game_3wBBv2p) Return true Force

##f$Init_Hero_Limped##
When f$pot_Limped
	When (Position = First) && (f$game_3wSBvBB) Return true Force
	When (Position = Last || Position = Middle) && (f$game_HUSB || f$game_3wBTN) Return true Force

##f$InButton_backup##
(currentbet = 0 && IsPreflop && f$FirstAction && OpponentsAtTable = 2)

##f$InSmallBlind_backup##
(currentbet = sblind && IsPreflop && f$FirstAction)

##f$InBigBlind_backup##
(currentbet = bblind && IsPreflop && f$FirstAction)

##f$inBB##
(InBigBlind || f$InBigBlind_backup)

##f$inSB##
(InSmallBlind || f$InSmallBlind_backup) && !f$inBB // add !InBB to f$InSB

##f$inBTN##
(InButton || (f$FirstAction && currentbet = 0))

##f$game_HUSB##
OpponentsAtTable = 1 && f$inSB //1

##f$game_HUBB##
OpponentsAtTable = 1 && f$inBB //2

##f$game_3wBTNvSB##
f$inBTN && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == smallblindchair) //3

##f$game_3wBTNvBB##
f$inBTN && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == bigblindchair) //4

##f$game_3wBTNv2p##
f$inBTN && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == -1) //5

##f$game_3wSBvBTN##
f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == dealerchair) // bb folded //6

##f$game_3wSBvBB##
f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == bigblindchair) //7

##f$game_3wSBv2p##
f$inSB && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == -1) //8

##f$game_3wBBvBTN##
f$inBB && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == dealerchair) && !(headsupchair == smallblindchair) //9

##f$game_3wBBvSB##
f$inBB && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == smallblindchair) //10

##f$game_3wBBv2p##
f$inBB && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == -1) //11

##f$game_3wBlinds_vBTN##
(f$inBB || f$inSB) && OpponentsAtTable = 2 && (headsupchair == -1)

##f$game_3wBTN##
f$game_3wBTNvBB || f$game_3wBTNvSB || f$game_3wBTNv2p

##f$game_AgainstTwo##
((f$Raises_BKP + Calls) > 1 || nopponentsallin > 1)

##f$ChipsInGame##
potcommon + balance0 + balance1 + balance2 + currentbet0 + currentbet + currentbet2

##f$WrongPot##
When pot != potcommon+potplayer Return true Force

##f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted##
When OpponentIsAllin Return true Force
When (f$Raises_BKP > 0 || Bets > 0) && BetSize > StackSize_raischair Return true Force
When HandIsHeadsup && (f$Raises_BKP > 0 || Bets > 0) && BetSize > StackSize*0.5 Return true Force

##f$StackBehind##
When StackSize >= (AmountToCall + StackSize_raischair) Return (AmountToCall + StackSize_raischair) Force
When StackSize < (AmountToCall + StackSize_raischair) Return StackSize Force

##f$Odds_and_Outs##
IsFlop ? (f$OutOdds*2.0)>f$PotOdds :
IsTurn ? (f$OutOdds*1.2)>f$PotOdds : 0

##f$R8_3wBBvBTN_AnyFrontdoorDraw##
// Source-local real draw detector for 3wBBvBTN. It uses existing OpenPPL primitives
// and deliberately does not redefine global f$hand_* semantics.
!IsRiver && (HaveStraightDraw || HaveInsideStraightDraw || HaveFlushDraw)

##f$R8_3wBBvBTN_SourceTurnDrawEquity##
// SS-147 source arithmetic: OESD ~16%, GS ~8%, FD ~18%, +~6% per overcard.
// Combo SD+FD uses additive direct-out approximation; best combo draws normally
// did not reach this X/C history because SS-148 X/Rs them on the flop.
When HaveFlushDraw && HaveStraightDraw Return 0.34 + 0.06*Overcards Force
When HaveFlushDraw Return 0.18 + 0.06*Overcards Force
When HaveStraightDraw Return 0.16 + 0.06*Overcards Force
When HaveInsideStraightDraw Return 0.08 + 0.06*Overcards Force
When Others Return 0 Force

##f$R8_3wBBvBTN_LowVVTurnDraw##
// R8 SS-147/151/153 - source VV: 2HC draw with no dead/zombie flag = Low VV.
// 1HC and/or vulnerable draws are deliberately High VV. This is a visibility/
// vulnerability helper, not a replacement made-hand classifier.
IsTurn && !f$hand_dead && !f$hand_zombie && (((HaveStraightDraw || HaveInsideStraightDraw) && (nstraightfillcommon - nstraightfill = 2)) || (HaveFlushDraw && SuitsInHand = 1))

##f$OutOdds##
// Equity
[ f$calc_Outs/46 ]

##f$PotOdds##
[call / (EffectivePotSizeInDollars + call + f$ImpliedOdds)]
    
##f$ImpliedOdds##
f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted ? 0 :
IsFlop ? ((nopponentsbetting*.50)*bet4*1.5) + (((nplayersplaying-1-nopponentsbetting)*.275)*bet4*1.25) : 
IsTurn ? ((nopponentsbetting*.50)*bet4) + (((nplayersplaying-1-nopponentsbetting)*.275)*bet4) : 0

##f$calc_Outs##
//HUBB CF Q1 Draws 03-03-2025
When f$draw_FD_2OC Return 11 Force
When f$draw_OESD_2OC_or_FD_1OC Return 10 Force
When f$draw_OESD_1OC_or_FD_or_OESD_2mOC Return 9 Force
When f$draw_OESD_UC Return 8 Force
When f$draw_GS_1OC Return 6 Force
When Others Return NOuts Force

##f$preflop_prob_win_BKP##
// devo criar mais formulas baseadas na agressividade do villain //default tight range

##f$headsup_pot_odds_calc##
When nplayersplaying<=2 && f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted Return f$pot_Odds Force
When Others Return 9999 Force

##f$pot_Odds##
When (AmountToCall + PotSize) = 0 && log$potOddsDivZero Return 0 Force
When OpponentIsAllin Return (AmountToCall / (AmountToCall + PotSize)) Force
When !OpponentIsAllin && StackSize_raischair <= StackSize  Return (AmountToCall+StackSize_raischair) / ((AmountToCall+StackSize_raischair) + (PotSize+StackSize_raischair)) Force
When !OpponentIsAllin && StackSize <= StackSize_raischair  Return (AmountToCall+StackSize) / ((AmountToCall+StackSize) + (PotSize+StackSize)) Force

##f$backup_opp_allin_range##
When f$OpponentIsRaisingCommitted && Opponents = 1
	When f$stack_14_UP Return 4 Force
	When f$stack_10_14 Return 6 Force
	When f$stack_08_10 Return 9 Force
	When f$stack_06_08 Return 12 Force
	When f$stack_00_06 Return 15 Force

##f$StackSize_raischair_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return StackSize_raischair Force // to detect limp whe Blinds update error occur.
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$StackSizeBackupERROR Return StackSize_raischair Force
When Others Return (balance_raischair / f$bblind_BKP) Force

##f$StackSize_headsupchair_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return StackSize_headsupchair Force 
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$StackSizeBackupERROR Return StackSize_headsupchair Force
When Others Return (balance_headsupchair / f$bblind_BKP) Force

##f$StackSize_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return StackSize Force 
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$StackSizeBackupERROR Return StackSize Force
When Others Return (balance / f$bblind_BKP) Force

##f$AmountToCall_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return AmountToCall Force 
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$AmountToCallBackupERROR Return AmountToCall Force
When Others Return (DollarsToCall / f$bblind_BKP) Force

##f$PotSize_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return PotSize Force 
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$PotSizeBackupERROR Return PotSize Force
When Others Return (pot / f$bblind_BKP) Force

##f$BetSize_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return BetSize Force 
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$BetSizeBackupERROR Return BetSize Force
When Others Return f$AmountToCall_BKP + (currentbet / f$bblind_BKP) Force

##f$BotsLastAction_BKP##
// change bblind by BigBlindSize
// Just to be extra safe...
WHEN [IsPreflop AND (f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP == 0)] RETURN None FORCE
// Computing BotsLastAction from prevation
// k_prevaction_undefined = -2
// k_prevaction_fold = -1
// k_prevaction_check = 0   // new in OpenHoldem
// k_prevaction_call = 1
// k_prevaction_raise = 2   // min-raise
// k_prevaction_betsize = 3	// "stated wager", i.e. using f$betsize
// k_prevaction_allin = 4
// k_prevaction_jam = 5     // allin with the slider
//
// We do no longer check for successful and failed allins
// because this function gets used for the initialization of BotsLastPreflopAction
// This update happens potentiually multiple times preflop, not only once on the flop,
// and at the same heartbeat when the action was executed,
// so we can't check if the balance is zero, as the casino did not yet update
// and we did not yet scrape again.
WHEN PrevActionWasAllin RETURN RaiseMax FORCE
// Raising (FL and NL)
WHEN ((prevaction == 2) OR (prevaction == 3)) RETURN Raise FORCE
// calling
WHEN (prevaction == 1) RETURN Call FORCE
// Checking postflop
WHEN ((prevaction == 0) AND (betround > 1) AND (currentbet == 0)) RETURN Check FORCE
// Checking preflop
WHEN ((prevaction == 0) AND (betround == 1) AND (currentbet <= f$bblind_BKP)) RETURN Check FORCE
// "Checking" when it was a call
// Actually OpenHoldem does auto-adapt prevaction after such actions
// but we try to be extra safe
WHEN ((prevaction == 0) AND (betround == 1) AND (currentbet > f$bblind_BKP)) RETURN Call FORCE
// Folding (might be used in sitout formulas)
WHEN (prevaction == -1) RETURN Fold FORCE
// No autoplayer-actions, but human being acting at ManualMode
WHEN sitename$openholdem RETURN (HINT_Counting_Only_Autoplayer_Actions_Not_Manual_User_Actions + None) FORCE
// None
WHEN (prevaction == -1) RETURN None FORCE
WHEN Others RETURN ERROR_IncorrectBotsLastAction FORCE

##f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP##
// Special condition to ease simulations at Manualmode 
// without the need for hand-resets
WHEN (IsPreflop AND (currentbet < f$bblind_BKP)) RETURN 0 FORCE
WHEN (BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecksAdapted < 0) RETURN 0 FORCE
WHEN Others RETURN BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecksAdapted FORCE

##f$Raises_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return Raises Force 
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$RaisesBackupERROR Return Raises Force
When Others 
	WHEN OpenPPLHistorySymbolsAlreadyUpdatedThisHeartbeatAfterAutoplayerAction RETURN me_re_MemRaises FORCE
	WHEN NOT GameStateChangedSinceLastAutoplayerAction RETURN me_re_MemRaises FORCE
	WHEN Others RETURN (me_re_MemRaises + f$RaisesSinceLastPlay_BKP) FORCE
	
##f$RaisesSinceLastPlay_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return RaisesSinceLastPlay Force 
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 && log$RaisesBackupERROR Return RaisesSinceLastPlay Force
When Others 
	WHEN (f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP == 0 && !InBigBlind) RETURN RaisesBeforeOurFirstAction - 1 FORCE //Because when there is blinds error post bb is a raise.
	WHEN (f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP == 0) RETURN RaisesBeforeOurFirstAction FORCE //Because when there is blinds error post bb is a raise.
	WHEN (f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP == 1) RETURN RaisesSinceLastPlayOnOurSecondAction FORCE
	WHEN (f$BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks_BKP >= 2) RETURN RaisesSinceLastPlayAfterOurSecondAction FORCE
	WHEN Others RETURN ERROR_BotsActionsOnThisRound_Out_Of_Range FORCE

##f$TheBiggestActiveOpponentsChips_BKP##
balance_bigstackchair + currentbet_bigstackchair

##f$TheBiggestActiveOpponentsStack_BKP##
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 Return -1 Force
When Others Return f$TheBiggestActiveOpponentsChips_BKP / f$bblind_BKP Force

##f$EffectiveStack_BKP##
When f$bblind_BKP <= 0 Return -1 Force
When (balance + currentbet) < f$TheBiggestActiveOpponentsChips_BKP Return (balance + currentbet) / f$bblind_BKP Force
When Others Return f$TheBiggestActiveOpponentsStack_BKP Force

##f$bblind_BKP##
When !user_BlindsERROR Return bblind Force 
When me_re_BigBlindBackup <= 0 && log$BlindsBackupERROR Return bblind Force
When Others Return me_re_BigBlindBackup Force

##f$draw_GS_1OC##
//6 outs 24% to river max call 6bbs //HUBB CF Q1 Draws 03-03-2025
When f$hand_Gutshot && Overcards = 1 Return true Force

##f$draw_OESD_UC##
//8 outs 32% to river max call 10bbs //HUBB CF Q1 Draws 03-03-2025
f$hand_SD && Overcards = 0 && !f$hand_mOC_or_better_over

##f$draw_OESD_1OC_or_FD_or_OESD_2mOC##
//9 outs 36% to river max call 13bbs //HUBB CF Q1 Draws 03-03-2025
When f$hand_SD && Overcards = 1 Return true Force
When f$hand_FD  && Overcards = 0 && !f$hand_mOC_or_better_over Return true Force
When f$hand_SD && f$hand_2mOC Return true Force

##f$draw_OESD_2OC_or_FD_1OC##
//10 outs 40% to river max call 18bbs //HUBB CF Q1 Draws 03-03-2025
When f$hand_SD && Overcards = 2 Return true Force
When f$hand_FD && Overcards = 1 Return true Force

##f$draw_FD_2OC##
//11 outs 44% to river max call 27bbs //HUBB CF Q1 Draws 03-03-2025
When f$hand_FD && Overcards = 2 Return true Force

##f$hand_2mOC##
(rankloplayer > SecondTopFlopCard) && !ispair

##f$hand_mOC_or_better_over##
When IndividualOvercardsOnBoard <= 1 Return true Force
When Overcards > 0 Return true Force

##f$hand_Gutshot_or_BetterDraw##
When IsRiver Return false Force
When f$hand_SD Return true Force
When f$hand_Gutshot Return true Force
When f$hand_FD Return true Force
When Overcards = 2 && (HaveBackdoorFlushDraw || HaveBackdoorStraightDraw) Return true Force
When IsFlop && (hand$A || hand$K) && Overcards >= 1 && (HaveBackdoorFlushDraw || HaveBackdoorStraightDraw) Return true Force //2024

##f$hand_Gutshot_or_BetterFDSD##
When IsRiver Return false Force
When f$hand_SD Return true Force
When f$hand_Gutshot Return true Force
When f$hand_FD Return true Force

##f$hand_FD##
   (HaveFlushDraw && SuitsInHand = 1) 
|| f$QueenHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlushDraw

##f$hand_SD##
   ( HaveStraightDraw && (nstraightfillcommon - nstraightfill = 2) )
|| HaveNutStraightDraw

##f$hand_GoodDraws##
When (f$hand_dead || f$hand_zombie) Return false Force
When IsFlop
	When f$hand_SD_or_FD || f$JackHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlushDraw Return true Force
	When f$hand_Gutshot && Overcards = 2 Return true Force
	When HaveStraightDraw && f$hand_2mOC Return true Force //1HC OESD+2mOC
	When f$hand_SD Return true Force
When IsTurn
	When f$hand_SD_or_FD && rankhiplayer >= 11 Return true Force
	When f$hand_SD_or_FD && f$hand_2mOC Return true Force
	When (HaveFlushDraw || HaveStraightDraw) && Overcards >= 1 Return true Force

##f$hand_MediumDraws##
When f$hand_dead || f$hand_zombie Return false Force
When HaveStraightDraw || HaveFlushDraw Return true Force //OESD 1HC (1 or 0 mOC)
When f$hand_Gutshot && Overcards > 0 Return true Force
When f$hand_Gutshot && f$hand_2mOC Return true Force

##f$hand_WeakDraws##
When f$hand_dead || f$hand_zombie Return false Force
When IsFlop
	When f$hand_Gutshot Return true Force
When IsTurn
	When f$hand_Gutshot Return true Force
	When (HaveFlushDraw || HaveStraightDraw) Return true Force
	When f$hand_Gutshot_or_BetterDraw Return true Force
	
##f$hand_2BarDraws##
When (f$hand_dead || f$hand_zombie) Return false Force 
When f$hand_FD && SuitsInHand = 1 Return true Force //HUSB CF Q5 Draws
When f$hand_SD && f$hand_mOC_or_better_over Return true FORCE //HUSB CF Q5 Draws
When f$hand_Gutshot && Overcards > 0 Return true Force //HUSB CF Q5 Draws 
When f$hand_Gutshot && f$hand_2mOC Return true Force //HUSB CF Q5 Draws

	
##f$HaveComboBackDoors##
(HaveBackdoorFlushDraw && HaveBackdoorStraightDraw)

##f$hand_Flush##
   (HaveFlush && SuitsInHand = 1 && nsuitedcommon = 3) 
|| f$QueenHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush

##f$hand_Straight##
HaveStraight

##f$hand_2HC_Straight##
   ( HaveStraight && (nstraightfillcommon - nstraightfill = 2) )
   
##f$hand_2HC_Flush##
   (HaveFlush && SuitsInHand = 1 && nsuitedcommon = 3)
   
##f$hand_1HC_Straight##
HaveStraight && !f$hand_2HC_Straight
   
##f$hand_1HC_Flush##
HaveFlush && !f$hand_2HC_Flush

##f$hand_1HC_King_Flush##
f$hand_1HC_Flush && f$KingHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush

##f$hand_1HC_Nine_Flush##
f$hand_1HC_Flush && f$NineHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush

##f$hand_1HC_Low_Flush##
f$hand_1HC_Flush && !f$EightHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush

##f$hand_Gutshot##
   ( HaveInsideStraightDraw && (nstraightfillcommon - nstraightfill = 2) )
|| HaveNutStraightDraw

##f$NoMadeHand##
!HavePair && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter

##f$hand_Air_or_JustGutShot##
(f$hand_Air || (f$hand_Gutshot && f$NoMadeHand)) && !f$hand_mOC_or_better_over

##f$hand_Gutshot_NoOvercard##
( HaveInsideStraightDraw && (nstraightfillcommon - nstraightfill = 2) ) && Overcards = 0

##f$hand_AnyPair##
   f$hand_5thTopPair_or_Pocket
|| f$hand_4thTopPair_or_Pocket
|| f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket
|| f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket
|| (f$hand_TopPairOrBetter && !f$hand_TripsOrBetter)

##f$hand_MPBP##
   f$hand_5thTopPair_or_Pocket
|| f$hand_4thTopPair_or_Pocket
|| f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket
|| f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket

##f$hand_PairOrBetter##
   (HavePair
OR HaveTwoPair
OR HaveSet
OR HaveTrips
OR f$hand_Straight
OR f$hand_Flush
OR HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$hand_OverPairOrBetter##
   (HaveOverPair
OR HaveTwoPair
OR HaveSet
OR HaveTrips
OR f$hand_Straight
OR f$hand_Flush
OR HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$hand_TwoPairsOrBetter##
   (HaveTwoPair
OR HaveSet
OR HaveTrips
OR f$hand_Straight
OR f$hand_Flush
OR HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$hand_TripsOrBetter##
     (HaveTrips
OR HaveSet
OR f$hand_Straight
OR f$hand_Flush
OR HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$hand_StraightOrBetter##
     (f$hand_Straight
OR f$hand_Flush
OR HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair##
[(betround >= flop) AND (ispair AND (rankhiplayer > HighestUnpairedBoardCard))]

##f$hand_TopPairOrBetter##
((HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair || f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair) || f$hand_OverPairOrBetter)

##f$hand_TPGKOrBetter##
( ((HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair || f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair) && f$NumberOfBetterKickers <= 3)  || f$hand_OverPairOrBetter)

##f$hand_TopPair2ndKickerOrBetter##
( ((HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair || f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair) && f$NumberOfBetterKickers <= 1)  || f$hand_OverPairOrBetter)

##f$hand_JustTopPair##
f$hand_TopPairOrBetter && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter

##f$hand_HighStrongFD##
f$hand_FD && (hand$A || hand$K || hand$Q)

##f$HaveStraightOrBetter##
     (HaveStraight
OR HaveFlush
OR HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$HaveFlushOrBetter##
     (HaveFlush
OR HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$HaveFullHouseOrBetter##
     (HaveFullHouse
OR HaveQuads
OR HaveStraightFlush)

##f$HaveOneCardStraightNotUnder##
f$hand_1HC_Straight && !HaveUnderStraight

##f$HaveOneCardUnderStraight##
f$hand_1HC_Straight && HaveUnderStraight

##f$JackHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlushDraw##
When HaveFlushDraw && SuitsInHand = 2
		When tsuitcommon = 0 && (hand$Ah || hand$Kh || hand$Qh || hand$Jh) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 1 && (hand$Ad || hand$Kd || hand$Qd || hand$Jd) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 2 && (hand$Ac || hand$Kc || hand$Qc || hand$Jc) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 3 && (hand$As || hand$Ks || hand$Qs || hand$Js) Return true Force
		When HaveFlushDraw AND (NumberOfUnknownSuitedOvercards <= 3) Return true Force //Accept Ten if K on board, for example.

##f$QueenHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlushDraw##
When HaveFlushDraw && SuitsInHand = 2
		When tsuitcommon = 0 && (hand$Ah || hand$Kh || hand$Qh) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 1 && (hand$Ad || hand$Kd || hand$Qd) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 2 && (hand$Ac || hand$Kc || hand$Qc) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 3 && (hand$As || hand$Ks || hand$Qs) Return true Force
		When HaveFlushDraw AND (NumberOfUnknownSuitedOvercards <= 2) Return true Force
		
##f$QueenHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush##
When HaveFlush && nsuitedcommon > 3
		When tsuitcommon = 0 && (hand$Ah || hand$Kh || hand$Qh) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 1 && (hand$Ad || hand$Kd || hand$Qd) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 2 && (hand$Ac || hand$Kc || hand$Qc) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 3 && (hand$As || hand$Ks || hand$Qs) Return true Force
		When HaveFlush AND (NumberOfUnknownSuitedOvercards <= 2) Return true Force
		
##f$KingHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush##
When HaveFlush && nsuitedcommon > 3
		When tsuitcommon = 0 && (hand$Ah || hand$Kh) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 1 && (hand$Ad || hand$Kd) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 2 && (hand$Ac || hand$Kc) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 3 && (hand$As || hand$Ks) Return true Force
		When HaveFlush AND (NumberOfUnknownSuitedOvercards <= 1) Return true Force
		
##f$AceHighContributingOnlyOneCardFlushDraw##
WHEN (nsuited != 4) RETURN false FORCE	
WHEN (nsuitedcommon != 3) RETURN false FORCE
WHEN (NumberOfUnknownSuitedOvercards <= 0) RETURN true FORCE
		
##f$NineHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush##
When HaveFlush && SuitsInHand = 2
		When tsuitcommon = 0 && (hand$Ah || hand$Kh || hand$Qh || hand$Jh || hand$Th || hand$9h) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 1 && (hand$Ad || hand$Kd || hand$Qd || hand$Jd || hand$Td || hand$9d) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 2 && (hand$Ac || hand$Kc || hand$Qc || hand$Jc || hand$Tc || hand$9c) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 3 && (hand$As || hand$Ks || hand$Qs || hand$Js || hand$Ts || hand$9s) Return true Force

##f$EightHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush##
When HaveFlush && SuitsInHand = 2
		When tsuitcommon = 0 && (hand$Ah || hand$Kh || hand$Qh || hand$Jh || hand$Th || hand$9h || hand$8h) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 1 && (hand$Ad || hand$Kd || hand$Qd || hand$Jd || hand$Td || hand$9d || hand$8d) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 2 && (hand$Ac || hand$Kc || hand$Qc || hand$Jc || hand$Tc || hand$9c || hand$8c) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 3 && (hand$As || hand$Ks || hand$Qs || hand$Js || hand$Ts || hand$9s || hand$8s) Return true Force

##f$NineToQueenContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush##
When HaveFlush && SuitsInHand = 2
		When tsuitcommon = 0 && (hand$Qh || hand$Jh || hand$Th || hand$9h) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 1 && (hand$Qd || hand$Jd || hand$Td || hand$9d) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 2 && (hand$Qc || hand$Jc || hand$Tc || hand$9c) Return true Force
		When tsuitcommon = 3 && (hand$Qs || hand$Js || hand$Ts || hand$9s) Return true Force
		
##f$LowMiddleCardContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush##
HaveFlush && SuitsInHand = 2 && !f$NineHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlush

##f$hand_2ndTopPair_low##
f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket && (SecondBestBoardCard <= 7 || (ispair && rankhiplayer <= 7)) && !(HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair || f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair) && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter

##f$hand_2ndTopPair_high##
f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket && (SecondBestBoardCard >= 8 || (ispair && rankhiplayer >= 8)) && !(HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair || f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair) && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter

##f$hand_BP_low##
HavePair && ThirdFlopCard <= 7 && !f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket && !(HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair || f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair) && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter

##f$hand_BP_high##
HavePair && ThirdFlopCard >= 8 && !f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket && !(HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair || f$HaveOverNonBoardPairedPocketPair) && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter

##f$hand_SD_or_FD##
!IsRiver && (f$hand_SD || f$hand_FD)

##f$hand_ComboDraw##
f$hand_SD && f$hand_FD

##f$hand_Air##
(!f$hand_Gutshot_or_BetterDraw && f$NoMadeHand)
|| (f$game_3wBTNvSB && f$NoMadeHand && !f$hand_StackOffDraws)

##f$hand_TPWK_or_WorstPair##
	(HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair && f$NumberOfBetterKickers > 3 && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter)
||  (HavePair && !HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter)

##f$hand_TPWK##
	(HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair && f$NumberOfBetterKickers > 3 && !f$hand_OverPairOrBetter)
	
##f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket##
(f$HaveSecondTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$hand_TopPairOrBetter) || (ispair && IndividualOvercardsOnBoard = 1)

##f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket##
(f$HaveThirdTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$HaveSecondTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$hand_TopPairOrBetter) || (ispair && IndividualOvercardsOnBoard = 2)

##f$hand_4thTopPair_or_Pocket##
(f$HaveFourthTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$HaveThirdTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$HaveSecondTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$hand_TopPairOrBetter) || (ispair && IndividualOvercardsOnBoard = 3)

##f$hand_5thTopPair_or_Pocket##
(f$HaveFifthTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$HaveFourthTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$HaveThirdTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$HaveSecondTopNonBoardPairedPair && !f$hand_TopPairOrBetter) || (ispair && IndividualOvercardsOnBoard = 4)

##f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket_or_Worst##
f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_4thTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_5thTopPair_or_Pocket || HaveUnderPair
 
##f$HaveSecondTopNonBoardPairedPair##
When HaveSecondTopPair Return true Force
When RankOfTopPairOnBoard > ThirdBestBoardCard && HaveThirdTopPair Return true Force
When Others Return false Force

##f$HaveThirdTopNonBoardPairedPair##
When HaveThirdTopPair Return true Force
When RankOfTopPairOnBoard > FourthBestBoardCard && HaveFourthTopPair Return true Force
When Others Return false Force

##f$HaveFourthTopNonBoardPairedPair##
When HaveFourthTopPair Return true Force
When RankOfTopPairOnBoard > FifthBestBoardCard && HaveFifthTopPair Return true Force
When Others Return false Force
	
##f$HaveFifthTopNonBoardPairedPair##
When HaveFifthTopPair Return true Force

##f$hand_StackOffDraws##
When Overcards >= 1 && HaveStraightDraw Return true Force //1OC + 1/2HC OESD
When Overcards >= 1 && (HaveFlushDraw && SuitsInHand = 1) Return true Force // 1OC + 2HC FD
When f$AceHighContributingOnlyOneCardFlushDraw Return true Force // NUT 1HD FD

// 05.1- KICKER FUNCTIONS 
//=============================================================================//
// https://www.maxinmontreal.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=18062&hilit=kicker&start=30
##f$MadeHandFifthCardRank##
// Useful for the determination of kickers
// The last 20 bits of pokerval encode the ranks of our made hand
// Four bits per card
(pokerval >> 0) & 0x0F

##f$PairRank##
WHEN NOT HavePair RETURN false FORCE
WHEN HaveTopPair RETURN TopPairRank FORCE
WHEN HaveSecondTopPair RETURN SecondTopPairRank FORCE
WHEN HaveThirdTopPair RETURN ThirdTopPairRank FORCE
WHEN HaveFourthTopPair RETURN FourthTopPairRank FORCE
WHEN HaveFifthTopPair RETURN FifthTopPairRank FORCE

##f$BestHoleCardRank##
RankOfFirstHoleCard > RankOfSecondHoleCard ? RankOfFirstHoleCard : RankOfSecondHoleCard

##f$SecondBestHoleCardRank##
RankOfFirstHoleCard < RankOfSecondHoleCard ? RankOfFirstHoleCard : RankOfSecondHoleCard

##f$BestNonPairedHoleCardRank##
WHEN f$BestHoleCardRank = f$PairRank RETURN f$SecondBestHoleCardRank FORCE
WHEN Others RETURN f$BestHoleCardRank FORCE

##f$MyKicker##
// Correction because when we do not have at least onepair, we have a high card, not kicker.
// WHEN f$BestNonPairedHoleCardRank >= f$MadeHandFifthCardRank RETURN f$BestNonPairedHoleCardRank FORCE
// WHEN Others RETURN f$MadeHandFifthCardRank FORCE

WHEN (isfourofakind OR istwopair OR isthreeofakind OR isonepair)
   WHEN f$BestNonPairedHoleCardRank >= f$MadeHandFifthCardRank RETURN f$BestNonPairedHoleCardRank FORCE
   WHEN Others RETURN f$MadeHandFifthCardRank FORCE
WHEN Others
   WHEN Others RETURN f$ERROR_You_Dont_Have_Any_Kicker FORCE

##f$ERROR_You_Dont_Have_Any_Kicker##
0

##f$NumberOfBetterKickers##
// Cards better than my kicker...
[(ace - f$MyKicker)
// ...minus the cards in my 5-card-hand which are better than my kicker
// (We have to shift the kicker out of rankbitspoker, therefore +1)
// http://www.maxinmontreal.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=156&t=17922
- (`(rankbitspoker >> (f$MyKicker + 1)))]

##f$HaveBestKicker##
(f$NumberOfBetterKickers == 0)

##f$HaveSecondBestKicker##
(f$NumberOfBetterKickers == 1)

##f$HaveThirdBestKicker##
(f$NumberOfBetterKickers == 2)

##f$HaveBestKickerOrBetter##
(f$HaveBestKicker OR HavePair OR HaveOverPairOrBetter)

##f$HaveSecondBestKickerOrBetter##
f$HaveSecondBestKicker OR f$HaveBestKickerOrBetter

##f$HaveThirdBestKickerOrBetter##
f$HaveThirdBestKicker OR f$HaveSecondBestKickerOrBetter
