##f$board_dry##
When f$board_DrawHeavy Return false Force
When IsFlop && f$flop_DrawHeavy Return false Force
When IsFlop && f$flop_dry_Plus Return true Force
When IsFlop && OpponentsAtTable = 1 && f$flop_dry_HU Return true Force
When IsFlop && OpponentsAtTable = 1 && !f$flop_dry_HU Return false Force
When IsFlop && OpponentsAtTable > 1 && f$flop_dry Return true Force
When IsTurn 
	When user_WetFlop Return false Force
	When SuitsOnBoard <= 2 Return false Force
	When f$hand_zombie Return false Force
	When nstraightcommon >= 3 Return false Force
	When Others Return true Force
When IsRiver
	When FlushPossible Return false Force
	When f$hand_zombie Return false Force
	When nstraightcommon >= 3 Return false Force
	When Others Return true Force
	
##f$R8_3wBTNvBB_TurnBothDraws##
// Source-local BOARD texture helper for 3wBTNvBB TP Q7 Probe Turn.
// Written condition: both straight-draw and flush-draw structures on TURN.
// nstraightcommon>=3 is the native connected-common-card signal; this deliberately
// avoids reusing f$board_DrawHeavy, whose straight component is flop-only.
IsTurn && FlushDrawPossible && nstraightcommon >= 3

##f$R8_3wBTNvBB_Q12_PassiveXRProfile##
// R8 v6 Q12 profile gap-fill using ONLY thresholds that already existed in R8 v5:
// GreenGuy = low total AFQ with >=100 hands; Low_Turn_Cbet = <=45% with >100;
// not High_Flop_CheckRaise = below the existing 20% high-XR boundary once sample
// is established by Low_Turn_Cbet. No new numeric player threshold is introduced.
f$GreenGuy && f$exploit_Low_Turn_Cbet && !f$exploit_High_Flop_CheckRaise

##f$board_DrawHeavy##
FlushDrawPossible && OpenEndedStraightDrawPossibleOnFlop

##f$flop_DrawHeavy##
SuitsOnFlop<=2 && OpenEndedStraightDrawPossibleOnFlop && !PairOnBoard

##f$flop_dry##
When IsFlop && OpponentsAtTable = 1 && f$flop_dry_HU Return true Force
When IsFlop && OpponentsAtTable = 1 && !f$flop_dry_HU Return false Force
When IsFlop && f$flop_DrawHeavy Return false Force
When SuitsOnFlop>=2 && !f$TwoConnectedCardsOnFlop && f$flop_spreaded  Return true Force
When SuitsOnFlop>=3 && !StraightPossible Return true Force
When SuitsOnFlop>=3 && !OpenEndedStraightDrawPossibleOnFlop Return true Force // add 20-01-2025

##f$flop_very_dry##
(SuitsOnFlop == 3) && !StraightPossibleOnFlop && !OpenEndedStraightDrawPossibleOnFlop

##f$flop_dry_spreaded_rainbow##
When SuitsOnFlop>=3 && !StraightPossible && f$flop_spreaded Return true Force

##f$board_wet_2025##
	FlushPossible //Completed flush - Ks8s2x2s
||	StraightPossible //Completed straight - QT5-8r
||	f$board_DrawHeavy //Draw heavy - QsQx5s-3x

##f$hand_dead##
// DC_R1 SOURCE: CrusherTBP f$hand_dead explicitly excludes f$hand_Flush.
// Restore that exclusion; retain the existing stronger-made-hand protection.
When f$hand_Flush Return false Force

When f$HaveFullHouseOrBetter Return false Force
When f$JackHighContributingToOnlyOneCardFlushDraw Return false Force
When nsuitedcommon >= 4 Return true Force

##f$hand_zombie##
When MoreThanOneOneCardStraightPossible && !f$HaveStraightOrBetter Return true Force 
When (board$KQJT || board$AQJT || board$AKJT || board$AKQT || board$AKQJ) && !f$HaveStraightOrBetter Return true Force 
When (board$KJT9 || board$KQT9 || board$QT98 || board$KQJ9 || board$QJ98 || board$J987 ) && !f$HaveStraightOrBetter Return true Force 
//When nstraightfillcommon = 1 && !f$HaveStraightOrBetter Return true Force 
When nstraightfillcommon = 1 && !f$HaveStraightOrBetter && f$board_2BW Return true Force // add board 2BW to not include all 1  fill common 23/03/2024

##f$board_dead##
When nsuitedcommon >= 4 Return true Force

##f$board_zombie##
When MoreThanOneOneCardStraightPossible Return true Force 
When (board$KQJT || board$AQJT || board$AKJT || board$AKQT || board$AKQJ) Return true Force 
When (board$KJT9 || board$KQT9 || board$QT98 || board$KQJ9 || board$QJ98 || board$J987 ) Return true Force

##f$flop_8high_NoPairOnBoard##
rankhicommon <= 8 && !PairOnBoard

##f$flop_low##
ranklocommon >= 2 && rankhicommon <= 5

##f$flop_OneOrMoreLowCards##
     [(FirstFlopCard <= 5)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard <= 5)]
||   [(ThirdFlopCard <= 5)]

##f$flop_2high##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 8) && (SecondFlopCard >= 8)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 8) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 8)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 8) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 8)]

##f$flop_2low##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 2 && FirstFlopCard <= 7) && (SecondFlopCard >= 2 && SecondFlopCard <= 7)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 2 && FirstFlopCard <= 7) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 2 && ThirdFlopCard <= 7)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 2 && SecondFlopCard <= 7) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 2 && ThirdFlopCard <= 7)]

##f$f$flop_2Cards_2_to_6##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 2 && FirstFlopCard <= 6) && (SecondFlopCard >= 2 && SecondFlopCard <= 6)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 2 && FirstFlopCard <= 6) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 2 && ThirdFlopCard <= 6)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 2 && SecondFlopCard <= 6) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 2 && ThirdFlopCard <= 6)]

##f$flop_2verylow##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 2 && FirstFlopCard <= 5) && (SecondFlopCard >= 2 && SecondFlopCard <= 5)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 2 && FirstFlopCard <= 5) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 2 && ThirdFlopCard <= 5)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 2 && SecondFlopCard <= 5) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 2 && ThirdFlopCard <= 5)]

##f$flop_2MC##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 6 && FirstFlopCard <= 9) && (SecondFlopCard >= 6 && SecondFlopCard <= 9)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 6 && FirstFlopCard <= 9) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 6 && ThirdFlopCard <= 9)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 6 && SecondFlopCard <= 9) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 6 && ThirdFlopCard <= 9)]

##f$flop_2Cards_7_to_K##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 7 && FirstFlopCard <= 13) && (SecondFlopCard >= 7 && SecondFlopCard <= 13)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 7 && FirstFlopCard <= 13) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 7 && ThirdFlopCard <= 13)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 7 && SecondFlopCard <= 13) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 7 && ThirdFlopCard <= 13)]

##f$flop_2Cards_8_to_K##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 8 && FirstFlopCard <= 13) && (SecondFlopCard >= 8 && SecondFlopCard <= 13)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 8 && FirstFlopCard <= 13) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 8 && ThirdFlopCard <= 13)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 8 && SecondFlopCard <= 13) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 8 && ThirdFlopCard <= 13)]

##f$turn_3Cards_8_to_K##
	(f$flop_2Cards_8_to_K && TurnCard >=8 && TurnCard <=13)
||	( (FirstFlopCard >= 8 && FirstFlopCard <= 13)
&& 	(SecondFlopCard >= 8 && SecondFlopCard <= 13)
&&	(ThirdFlopCard >= 8 && ThirdFlopCard <= 13) )

##f$flop_ZeroMC##
     [(FirstFlopCard < 6 || FirstFlopCard > 9)]
&&   [(SecondFlopCard < 6 || SecondFlopCard > 9)]
&&   [(ThirdFlopCard < 6 || ThirdFlopCard > 9)]

##f$flop_spreaded##
     (FirstFlopCard >= 11 || SecondFlopCard >= 11 || ThirdFlopCard >= 11)
&&   ( (FirstFlopCard >= 7 && FirstFlopCard <= 10) || (SecondFlopCard >= 7 && SecondFlopCard <= 10) || (ThirdFlopCard >= 7 && ThirdFlopCard <= 10))
&&   ( (FirstFlopCard >= 2 && FirstFlopCard <= 6) || (SecondFlopCard >= 2 && SecondFlopCard <= 6) || (ThirdFlopCard >= 2 && ThirdFlopCard <= 6))

##f$flop_3BW##
FirstFlopCard >= 10 && SecondFlopCard >= 10 && ThirdFlopCard >= 10

##f$flop_2BW##
     [(FirstFlopCard >= 10 && FirstFlopCard <= 14) && (SecondFlopCard >= 10 && SecondFlopCard <= 14)]
||   [(FirstFlopCard >= 10 && FirstFlopCard <= 14) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 10 && ThirdFlopCard <= 14)]
||   [(SecondFlopCard >= 10 && SecondFlopCard <= 14) && (ThirdFlopCard >= 10 && ThirdFlopCard <= 14)]

##f$flop_1BW##
!f$flop_3BW && !f$flop_2BW && !f$flop_0BW

##f$flop_0BW##
FirstFlopCard < 10 && SecondFlopCard < 10 && ThirdFlopCard < 10

##f$flop_QueenPlus##
(AcePresentOnFlop || KingPresentOnFlop || QueenPresentOnFlop)

##f$nQueensPlus##
  f$First_QueenPlus
+ f$Second_QueenPlus
+ f$Third_QueenPlus
+ f$Turn_QueenPlus
+ f$River_QueenPlus

##f$First_QueenPlus##
  (FirstFlopCard >= 12 ? 1 : 0)
  
##f$Second_QueenPlus##
  (SecondFlopCard >= 12 ? 1 : 0)
  
##f$Third_QueenPlus##
  (ThirdFlopCard >= 12 ? 1 : 0)
  
##f$Turn_QueenPlus##
  (TurnCard >= 12 ? 1 : 0)
  
##f$River_QueenPlus##
  (RiverCard >= 12 ? 1 : 0)

##f$board_2BW##
   (f$flop_2BW && TurnCard < 10 && RiverCard < 10)
|| (f$flop_1BW && (TurnCard >= 10 || RiverCard >= 10))
|| (f$flop_0BW && (TurnCard >= 10 && RiverCard >= 10))

##f$board_3BW##
   (f$flop_3BW)
|| (f$flop_2BW && (TurnCard >= 10 || RiverCard >= 10))
|| (f$flop_1BW && (TurnCard >= 10 && RiverCard >= 10))

##f$flop_MonoTone##
SuitsOnBoard = 1

##f$flop_HUSB_NotLimped##
IsFlop && f$game_HUSB && !f$pot_Limped

##f$flop_HUSB_Limped##
IsFlop && f$game_HUSB && f$pot_Limped

##f$flop_HUBB_NotLimped##
IsFlop && f$game_HUBB && !f$pot_Limped

##f$flop_HUBB_Limped##
IsFlop && f$game_HUBB && f$pot_Limped

##f$flop_Wet_Plus_HU##
	[ f$flop_HUSB_NotLimped && (StraightPossibleOnFlop || f$flop_8high_NoPairOnBoard) ]
||  [ f$flop_HUSB_Limped && (StraightPossibleOnFlop) ]

##f$flop_Wet_HU##
	(f$flop_HUSB_NotLimped && f$flop_2MC)
||	[ f$flop_HUBB_NotLimped && (StraightPossibleOnFlop || f$flop_DrawHeavy || (AcePresentOnFlop && !PairOnFlop))]
||  [ f$flop_HUBB_Limped && (StraightPossibleOnFlop || f$flop_DrawHeavy) ]

##f$flop_Wet_HUBB_NewCF##
f$flop_HUBB_NotLimped && f$flop_2Cards_7_to_K

##f$flop_dry_HU##
	[ f$flop_HUSB_NotLimped && !(f$flop_Wet_Plus_HU || f$flop_Wet_HU)] 
||	[ f$flop_HUSB_Limped && !(StraightPossibleOnFlop)]
||	[ f$flop_HUBB_NotLimped && !f$flop_Wet_HU ]
||  [ f$flop_HUBB_NotLimped && f$flop_1BW && PairOnBoard && (!OpenEndedStraightDrawPossibleOnFlop || WheelPossible) ] //Super Dry
||	[ f$flop_HUBB_Limped && (PairOnBoard || (f$flop_2BW && f$flop_OneOrMoreLowCards || AcePresentOnFlop))  ] //Super Dry
||	[ f$flop_HUBB_Limped && !(StraightPossibleOnFlop)]
||  [ f$flop_MonoTone && !StraightPossibleOnFlop && (f$flop_HUSB_NotLimped || f$flop_HUSB_Limped) ] //aditional rule

##f$flop_Paired_Plus##
PairOnFlop && (TopFlopCard - SecondTopFlopCard >= 5)

##f$flop_dry_Plus##
   (f$flop_HUBB_Limped && (PairOnBoard || f$flop_ZeroMC))
|| (f$game_3wBTN && UncoordinatedFlop && !f$TwoConnectedCardsOnFlop) // not defined on pdf. // Uncoord = 3suits, no pair, no open-end, no straight

##f$flop_SuperCompleted##
(FlushPossibleOnFlop && StraightPossibleOnFlop)

##f$flop_Completed##
(FlushPossibleOnFlop || StraightPossibleOnFlop)

##f$turn_SuperCompleted##
(FlushPossibleOnTurn && StraightPossibleOnTurn)

##f$turn_Completed##
(FlushPossibleOnTurn || StraightPossibleOnTurn)

##f$river_SuperCompleted##
(FlushPossible && StraightPossible)

##f$river_Completed##
(FlushPossible || StraightPossible)

##f$TurnCardCompletedTheBoard##
When !StraightPossibleOnFlop && StraightPossibleOnTurn Return true Force
When !FlushPossibleOnFlop && SuitsOnFlop = 2 && FlushPossibleOnTurn Return true Force

##f$RiverCardCompletedTheBoard##
When !StraightPossibleOnTurn && StraightPossible Return true Force
When !FlushPossibleOnTurn && user_FlushDrawPossible_OTT && FlushPossible Return true Force

##f$MissedFlushDrawsOTR##
user_FlushDrawPossible_OTT && !FlushPossible

##f$turn_mOC##
When SecondTopFlopCard < TurnCard Return true Force
When TurnCardIsOvercardToBoard > 0 Return true Force

##f$river_mOC##
When SecondTopFlopCard < RiverCard Return true Force
When RiverCardIsOvercardToBoard > 0 Return true Force

##f$board_2bOC##
(TurnCard > LowestFlopCard) && (RiverCard > LowestFlopCard)

##f$turn_Under##
TurnCard < LowestFlopCard

##f$turn_Grued_Overcard##
TurnCard - TopFlopCard = 1

##f$river_UnderFlop##
RiverCard < LowestFlopCard

##f$river_UnderBoard##
(RiverCard < LowestFlopCard) && (RiverCard < TurnCard)

##f$turn_Paired##
	(FirstFlopCard == TurnCard)
|| 	(SecondFlopCard  == TurnCard)
|| 	(ThirdFlopCard  == TurnCard)

##f$river_Paired##
	(FirstFlopCard == RiverCard)
|| 	(SecondFlopCard  == RiverCard)
|| 	(ThirdFlopCard  == RiverCard)
|| 	(TurnCard  == RiverCard)

##f$river_Paired_TopCard##
// TurnCardIsOvercardToBoard -> Turn maior que o Flop | TurnCardPaired -> TurnCard = River ard
((TopFlopCard > TurnCard) && TopFlopCardPairedOnRiver) || ((TurnCard > TopFlopCard) && TurnCardPaired)

##f$river_Paired_2ndTopCard##
   ((SecondTopFlopCard > TurnCard) && SecondTopFlopCardPairedOnRiver) 
|| ((TurnCard > SecondTopFlopCard) && (TurnCard < TopFlopCard) && TurnCardPaired) 
|| ((TurnCard > SecondTopFlopCard) && (TurnCard > TopFlopCard) && TopFlopCardPairedOnRiver)

##f$river_Paired_3rdTopCard##
   ((LowestFlopCard > TurnCard) && (LowestFlopCard == RiverCard)) 
|| ((TurnCard > LowestFlopCard) && (TurnCard < SecondTopFlopCard) && TurnCardPaired) 
|| ((TurnCard > LowestFlopCard) && (TurnCard > SecondTopFlopCard) && SecondTopFlopCardPairedOnRiver)

##f$river_Paired_4thTopCard##
((LowestFlopCard < TurnCard) && (LowestFlopCard == RiverCard)) || ((TurnCard < LowestFlopCard) && TurnCardPaired)


##f$HighTurnCardIsOvercardToBoard##
When TurnCardIsOvercardToBoard && (TurnCard==ace || TurnCard==king || TurnCard==queen) Return true Force

##f$TwoConnectedCardsOnFlop##
//not wheel
   [(FirstFlopCard==king OR SecondFlopCard==king OR ThirdFlopCard==king) && (FirstFlopCard==queen OR SecondFlopCard==queen OR ThirdFlopCard==queen)] 
OR [(FirstFlopCard==queen OR SecondFlopCard==queen OR ThirdFlopCard==queen) && (FirstFlopCard==jack OR SecondFlopCard==jack OR ThirdFlopCard==jack)]
OR [(FirstFlopCard==jack OR SecondFlopCard==jack OR ThirdFlopCard==jack) && (FirstFlopCard==ten OR SecondFlopCard==ten OR ThirdFlopCard==ten)]
OR [(FirstFlopCard==ten OR SecondFlopCard==ten OR ThirdFlopCard==ten) && (FirstFlopCard==Nine OR SecondFlopCard==Nine OR ThirdFlopCard==Nine)]
OR [(FirstFlopCard==Nine OR SecondFlopCard==Nine OR ThirdFlopCard==Nine) && (FirstFlopCard==Eight OR SecondFlopCard==Eight OR ThirdFlopCard==Eight)]
OR [(FirstFlopCard==Eight OR SecondFlopCard==Eight OR ThirdFlopCard==Eight) && (FirstFlopCard==Seven OR SecondFlopCard==Seven OR ThirdFlopCard==Seven)]
OR [(FirstFlopCard==Seven OR SecondFlopCard==Seven OR ThirdFlopCard==Seven) && (FirstFlopCard==Six OR SecondFlopCard==Six OR ThirdFlopCard==Six)]
OR [(FirstFlopCard==Six OR SecondFlopCard==Six OR ThirdFlopCard==Six) && (FirstFlopCard==Five OR SecondFlopCard==Five OR ThirdFlopCard==Five)]
OR [(FirstFlopCard==Five OR SecondFlopCard==Five OR ThirdFlopCard==Five) && (FirstFlopCard==Four OR SecondFlopCard==Four OR ThirdFlopCard==Four)]

##f$ThreeConnectedCardsOnFlop##
//not count A 2 3
When PairOnBoard Return false Force
When TopFlopCard - LowestFlopCard = 2 Return true Force

##f$ThreeConnectedCardsOnTurn##
//not wheel
When f$TwoConnectedCardsOnFlop
	When TurnCard = LowestFlopCard - 1 Return true Force
	When TurnCard = TopFlopCard + 1 Return true Force
	
##f$ThreeConnectedCardsOnRiver##
//not wheel
//not counting turn card
When f$TwoConnectedCardsOnFlop
	When RiverCard = LowestFlopCard - 1 Return true Force
	When RiverCard = TopFlopCard + 1 Return true Force

##f$BestBetsize##
// DC_R1 SOURCE: CrusherTBP commitment intent + runtime action routing.
// A true commitment decision must produce BetMax before any sticky sizing flag.
// Preflop retains its existing independent routing.
When !IsPreflop && f$Raise_Committed Return BetMax Force

// CF7: decision functions decide CALL/RAISE. This router only chooses the size of a raise/bet.
When IsPreflop Return f$BetsizePreflop Force
When HandIsHeadsup && IsFlop Return f$BetsizeFlopHeadsup Force
When HandIsHeadsup && IsTurn Return f$BetsizeTurnHeadsup Force
When HandIsHeadsup && IsRiver Return f$BetsizeRiverHeadsup Force
When !HandIsHeadsup && IsFlop Return f$BetsizeFlopMultiway Force
When !HandIsHeadsup && IsTurn Return f$BetsizeTurnMultiway Force
When !HandIsHeadsup && IsRiver Return f$BetsizeRiverMultiway Force
When Others Return BetHalfPot Force

##f$BetsizePreflop##
When f$UnplayedPot
	When Others BetMin Force 
		
When (f$sb_vs_Open_Raise_Normal || f$sb_got_Limped)
	When f$EffectiveStack_BKP > 20 RaiseTo (AmountToCall + 4) Force
    When f$EffectiveStack_BKP > 16 RaiseTo (AmountToCall + 3.5) Force
		When Others RaiseTo (AmountToCall + 3) Force
		
When f$bb_vs_Open_Raise_Normal 
	When f$dealer_lastraised && f$EffectiveStack_BKP > 20 RaiseTo (AmountToCall + 5.5) Force 
	When f$sb_lastraised_2H_or_3H && f$EffectiveStack_BKP > 20 RaiseTo (AmountToCall + 6) Force
	When Others RaiseTo (AmountToCall + 4) Force
		
When f$bb_got_Limped
	When f$EffectiveStack_BKP > 16 RaiseTo (Calls + 2) Force
	When Others RaiseTo (Calls + 1.5) Force
		
When Others
	When Others BetMax Force
   
##f$BetsizeFlopHeadsup##
// R8 v12 SS-242 - SBvBTN good-draw stack-off re-raise outranks sticky Flop50.
When AmountToCall > 0 && f$game_3wSBvBTN && user_R8_3wSBvBTN_GoodDraw_FlopXR && user_Shove_vs_XR BetMax Force
// R8 v11 SS-230 - stack-off draw re-raise must outrank sticky initial Flop50.
When AmountToCall > 0 && f$game_3wBTNvSB && user_Bet_StackOffDraws && user_Shove_vs_XR BetMax Force
// R8 v8 SS-208 exact BB-denominated MP flop sizes.
When AmountToCall = 0 && user_R8_3wBTNvBB_MP_Flop15 RaiseTo 1.5 Force
When AmountToCall = 0 && user_R8_3wBTNvBB_MP_Flop225 RaiseTo 2.25 Force
// DC_R1 SOURCE: supplied OpenHoldem/OPPL units.
// Express currentbet in BB before comparing with the effective-stack target in BB.
// STATIC CLOSURE - exact 3wSBvBTN TP+ source X/R target.
// SOURCE: STARTING_STRATEGY - raise to 6bb regardless of ordinary CBet size at the 25bb model.
// SOURCE: USER_HARDCODED - corroborates a target total of 6bb; its discrete action chooser approximated it.
// SOURCE: OPENHOLDEM_RUNTIME - RaiseTo expression is denominated in big blinds and runtime betsize adjustment clamps to legal min/max.
// SOURCE: RECONCILED - use exact RaiseTo 6 rather than a percentage proxy; state exists only on the initial non-Axx TP+ flop X/R decision.
// DC_R1 SOURCE: original source target is the first flop X/R; user flags persist for the hand.
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCO_3wSBvBTN_TP_FlopXR6 RaiseTo 6 Force

// R8 v19 SS-328 - source Good-Draw stack-off must outrank sticky initial R50.
When AmountToCall > 0 && f$game_3wBBvSB && user_R8_3wBBvSB_Draw_FB_GoodStackOff3Bet BetMax Force
// R8 v19 SS-328/329 - initial source draw raise. Good source 3x is normalized to
// project R50; Med/Weak source gives no raise size, so mature R50 gap-fill is preserved.
When AmountToCall > 0 && !didbetsize && user_R8_3wBBvSB_Draw_FB_Raise50 RaiseBy 50% Force
// R8 v18 SS-320: exact initial Facing-Bet R50; scope prevents later-flop leakage.
When AmountToCall > 0 && !didbetsize && user_R8_3wBBvSB_MPBP_FB_Raise50 RaiseBy 50% Force
// SOURCE: STARTING_STRATEGY + USER_HARDCODED - 3wBBvSB TP/OP raise vs flop Facing-Bet uses 50% pot.
// Keep this sizing state scoped to the initial Facing-Bet action so it cannot leak into a later flop re-raise decision.
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCR_3wBBvSB_TP_FB_Raise50 RaiseBy 50% Force
// SOURCE: STARTING_STRATEGY + USER_HARDCODED - 3wBTNvBB TP/OP raise vs flop Facing-Bet targets one-third of effective stack.
// If the legal minimum raise already reaches the target, use all-in rather than an illegal under-raise.
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCR_3wBTNvBB_TP_FB_Raised && ((currentbet / bblind) + 2*AmountToCall) >= 0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP BetMax Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCR_3wBTNvBB_TP_FB_Raised RaiseTo (0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP) Force

// Retro01 exact source sizes and exact check-raise geometry.
// If the legal minimum re-raise already reaches the source one-third-stack
// target, the source plan becomes all-in rather than an illegal under-raise.
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wBTNvBB_TPGK_Wet_RaiseXR && ((currentbet / bblind) + 2*AmountToCall) >= 0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP BetMax Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wBTNvBB_TPGK_Wet_RaiseXR RaiseTo (0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP) Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wSBvBB_TP_CheckRaiseFlop && ((currentbet / bblind) + 2*AmountToCall) >= 0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP BetMax Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wSBvBB_TP_CheckRaiseFlop RaiseTo (0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP) Force
// R8 v16 SS-290/291 - eligible flop 3bet stack-off is JAM and must precede
// the sticky source state used for the initial X/R50.
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_R8_3wSBvBB_GoodDraw_StackOff3Bet BetMax Force
// Good-draw initial X/R in 3wSBvBB is source "X/R 50%" (raise by half pot).
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wSBvBB_GoodDraw_CheckRaise RaiseBy 50% Force

When AmountToCall = 0 && user_Flop60 && StackSize > 0 && (0.60*PotSize) >= 0.60*StackSize BetMax Force
When AmountToCall = 0 && user_Flop60 RaiseBy 60% Force
When AmountToCall = 0 && user_Flop30 && StackSize > 0 && (0.30*PotSize) >= 0.60*StackSize BetMax Force
When AmountToCall = 0 && user_Flop30 RaiseBy 30% Force

// SOURCE: USER_HARDCODED - corroborates a target total of 6bb; its discrete action chooser approximated it.
// SOURCE: OPENHOLDEM_RUNTIME - RaiseTo expression is denominated in big blinds and runtime betsize adjustment clamps to legal min/max.
// SOURCE: RECONCILED - use exact RaiseTo 6 rather than a percentage proxy; state exists only on the initial non-Axx TP+ flop X/R decision.
// DC_R1 SOURCE: original source target is the first flop X/R; user flags persist for the hand.
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCO_3wSBvBTN_TP_FlopXR6 RaiseTo 6 Force

// project R50; Med/Weak source gives no raise size, so mature R50 gap-fill is preserved.
When AmountToCall > 0 && !didbetsize && user_R8_3wBBvSB_Draw_FB_Raise50 RaiseBy 50% Force
// R8 v18 SS-320: exact initial Facing-Bet R50; scope prevents later-flop leakage.
When AmountToCall > 0 && !didbetsize && user_R8_3wBBvSB_MPBP_FB_Raise50 RaiseBy 50% Force
// SOURCE: STARTING_STRATEGY + USER_HARDCODED - 3wBBvSB TP/OP raise vs flop Facing-Bet uses 50% pot.
// Keep this sizing state scoped to the initial Facing-Bet action so it cannot leak into a later flop re-raise decision.
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCR_3wBBvSB_TP_FB_Raise50 RaiseBy 50% Force
// SOURCE: STARTING_STRATEGY + USER_HARDCODED - 3wBTNvBB TP/OP raise vs flop Facing-Bet targets one-third of effective stack.
// If the legal minimum raise already reaches the target, use all-in rather than an illegal under-raise.
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCR_3wBTNvBB_TP_FB_Raised && ((currentbet / bblind) + 2*AmountToCall) >= 0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP BetMax Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet || f$act_3_vs_overbet) && user_DCR_3wBTNvBB_TP_FB_Raised RaiseTo (0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP) Force

When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wBTNvBB_TPGK_Wet_RaiseXR RaiseTo (0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP) Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wSBvBB_TP_CheckRaiseFlop && ((currentbet / bblind) + 2*AmountToCall) >= 0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP BetMax Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wSBvBB_TP_CheckRaiseFlop RaiseTo (0.33*f$EffectiveStack_BKP) Force
When AmountToCall > 0 && user_DC1R_3wSBvBB_GoodDraw_CheckRaise RaiseBy 50% Force

	When f$act_6_vs_lowbet && !(f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket) Set user_Raised_vs_Donk
	When (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet) && ( (f$hand_Gutshot_or_BetterFDSD && Overcards > 0) || f$hand_SD_or_FD || (f$flop_2low && f$hand_TopPairOrBetter)) Set user_Raised_vs_Donk
	When user_Raised_vs_Donk Return true Force

When IsTurn && f$inBB && Position = First && !f$hand_TopPairOrBetter && !f$act_6_vs_lowbet Return false Force //20%
When IsTurn && f$inBB && Position = Last && f$hand_Gutshot_or_BetterDraw && f$act_6_vs_lowbet Return true Force //20%
When IsRiver && f$inBB && Position = First && !user_NoactionOnFlop && !user_NoactionOnTurn && f$hand_TPWK_or_WorstPair && f$river_Completed Return false Force //20%
When IsTurn && ( (f$hand_Call_or_Bet_Two_Times || f$turn_Calling_With_Weak_Pairs) || (user_NoactionOnFlop && f$hand_Call_or_Bet_One_Time)) Return true Force
When IsRiver && ((user_NoactionOnFlop && user_NoactionOnTurn && HavePair) || ((user_NoactionOnFlop || user_NoactionOnTurn) && f$hand_Call_or_Bet_Two_Times) || f$hand_TopPairOrBetter) Return true Force
When IsRiver && f$river_Calling_With_Weak_Pairs Return true Force
When IsRiver && f$game_HUSB && f$act_8_vs_verylowbet && !f$river_Completed && f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket Return true Force //HUSB CF Q10 MP/BP add 07-01-2025

	When f$hand_slowplay Return true Force
	When f$act_6_vs_lowbet && (f$hand_3rdTopPair_or_Pocket || f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket) Return true Force
	When (f$act_1_vs_normalbet || f$act_2_vs_highbet) && ( (f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket) || (f$hand_TopPairOrBetter)) Return true Force

When f$game_3wSBvBB && IsTurn //20-06-2023 - Aqui tambem temos o call vs floatbet (vilao fazendo donk IP)
	When user_AirOTF && f$hand_2ndTopPair_or_Pocket && f$act_6_vs_lowbet Return true Force
